questions.question: True or false: the original VXLAN specification defines both a standardized data plane and a standardized control plane.

options.A: False, VXLAN defines only a control plane and relies on other protocols for data encapsulation
options.B: False, the original specification defines only the data-plane encapsulation, leaving the control plane open
options.C: True, but only for multicast-based deployments
options.D: True, VXLAN mandates a specific control plane protocol

questions.explanation_es: La especificación original de VXLAN, RFC 7348, solo define la encapsulación del plano de datos; el plano de control, por ejemplo inundación con multicast o EVPN, no forma parte obligatoria de esa especificación.

questions.name: VXLAN EVPN/BUM
questions.question: What is the name of the identifier that uniquely designates a virtual Layer 2 segment within a VXLAN overlay?

options.A: VTEP address
options.B: VXLAN Network Identifier (VNI)
options.C: Endpoint identifier (EID)
options.D: VLAN tag

questions.explanation_es: El VNI, VXLAN Network Identifier, es el identificador de 24 bits que distingue cada segmento de red virtual dentro del overlay VXLAN.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT generally considered a benefit of the hierarchical (multi-layer) LAN design model?

options.A: It simplifies troubleshooting by isolating faults to a specific layer
options.B: It is the design of choice for modern data center fabrics
options.C: It scales more easily as the campus grows
options.D: It speeds up problem isolation during outages

questions.explanation_es: El modelo jerárquico de LAN (acceso-distribución-núcleo) fue diseñado para redes de campus, no para centros de datos modernos, que suelen usar arquitecturas leaf-spine u otras fabrics específicas. Las demás opciones sí son beneficios reconocidos del diseño jerárquico.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: In hierarchical campus design terminology, the access layer is also commonly referred to as the ____.

options.A: policy boundary layer
options.B: aggregation layer
options.C: end-user layer
options.D: network edge

questions.explanation_es: La capa de acceso es donde los endpoints se conectan a la red, por lo que también se le conoce como el borde de la red (network edge). La agregación corresponde a la capa de distribución, no a la de acceso.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: In a hierarchical LAN design building block, how many distribution switches are typically deployed for redundancy?

options.A: There is no practical limit
options.B: Six
options.C: Two
options.D: Four

questions.explanation_es: El bloque de diseño jerárquico normalmente despliega un par de switches de distribución interconectados entre sí, lo que brinda redundancia sin agregar complejidad innecesaria.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which enterprise campus architecture is also commonly known as the collapsed-core design?

options.A: Leaf-spine design
options.B: SD-Access fabric design
options.C: Two-tier design
options.D: Three-tier design

questions.explanation_es: En el diseño de dos capas (two-tier), las funciones del núcleo y la distribución se combinan en un solo par de switches, por lo que se le llama diseño de núcleo colapsado (collapsed-core).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which two network blocks are typically used to provide end users with access to public cloud providers? (Choose two.)

options.A: WAN edge block
options.B: Network services block
options.C: Internet edge block
options.D: Data center block

questions.explanation_es: El acceso a proveedores de nube pública para los usuarios finales normalmente se realiza a través del bloque de borde de WAN (para conectividad directa vía MPLS/Internet dedicado) y el bloque de borde de Internet (para tráfico hacia Internet y SaaS).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a recommended technique for building a simplified (collapsed) two-tier campus design?

options.A: Daisy-chaining access switches to each other
options.B: StackWise Virtual (SWV)
options.C: Switch stacking
options.D: Virtual Switching System (VSS)

questions.explanation_es: Las tecnologías de clustering virtual como VSS, StackWise Virtual y el apilamiento de switches simplifican el diseño de campus al presentar varios chasis como un solo switch lógico. Encadenar switches de acceso entre sí (daisy-chaining) no es una práctica recomendada, ya que introduce puntos de falla y complica la topología.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which layer of the hierarchical LAN design model defines the Layer 3 summarization boundary for routing protocols and acts as the network's policy enforcement boundary?

options.A: WAN edge layer
options.B: Distribution layer
options.C: Access layer
options.D: Core layer

questions.explanation_es: La capa de distribución agrega los switches de acceso, resume las rutas hacia el núcleo y funciona como el límite lógico donde se aplican políticas de control (ACLs, QoS, filtrado de rutas).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: What is the primary motivation for choosing a two-tier (collapsed-core) design over a three-tier design?

options.A: It provides greater overall scalability than a three-tier design
options.B: It reduces cost while retaining most of the benefits of a three-tier design
options.C: It is mandatory for deploying first-hop redundancy protocols
options.D: It removes the need for any Layer 3 boundary in the campus

questions.explanation_es: El diseño de dos capas fusiona el núcleo y la distribución en un solo par de switches, reduciendo el costo del hardware y la complejidad de cableado, mientras conserva la mayoría de los beneficios del diseño de tres capas para campus más pequeños.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the five essential characteristics of cloud computing as defined by NIST?

options.A: On-demand self-service
options.B: Measured service
options.C: Customer-provided software licensing
options.D: Rapid elasticity

questions.explanation_es: El NIST define cinco características esenciales de la nube: autoservicio bajo demanda, acceso amplio a la red, agrupación de recursos (resource pooling), elasticidad rápida y servicio medido. El licenciamiento provisto por el cliente no forma parte de esa definición.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which NIST essential characteristic of cloud computing refers to the provider's ability to monitor, control, and report resource consumption on a per-consumer basis?

options.A: Broad network access
options.B: Rapid elasticity
options.C: Resource pooling
options.D: Measured service

questions.explanation_es: El servicio medido (measured service) es la característica que permite al proveedor y al consumidor tener visibilidad y transparencia sobre el consumo de almacenamiento, cómputo y ancho de banda, típicamente para fines de facturación.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which three cloud service models are defined by NIST? (Choose three.)

options.A: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.B: Backend as a Service (BaaS)
options.C: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.D: Software as a Service (SaaS)

questions.explanation_es: El NIST define tres modelos de servicio en la nube: software como servicio (SaaS), infraestructura como servicio (IaaS) y plataforma como servicio (PaaS). Backend as a Service no es uno de los modelos definidos por el NIST.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud service model gives the consumer the ability to provision compute, storage, and network resources while the consumer retains control over the operating systems and applications deployed on top?

options.A: Function as a Service (FaaS)
options.B: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.C: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.D: Platform as a Service (PaaS)

questions.explanation_es: IaaS entrega al consumidor recursos de cómputo, almacenamiento y red bajo demanda, dejando a su cargo el sistema operativo, las aplicaciones y su mantenimiento, mientras el proveedor gestiona la infraestructura física subyacente.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud service model allows consumers to build and run applications using the provider's programming languages, libraries, and tools, without having to manage the underlying compute, network, or storage?

options.A: Colocation services
options.B: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.C: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.D: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)

questions.explanation_es: PaaS ofrece un entorno de desarrollo con lenguajes de programación, bibliotecas, servicios y herramientas, mientras el proveedor de la nube mantiene el control de la infraestructura subyacente (cómputo, red y almacenamiento).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which three of the following are cloud deployment models, as opposed to cloud service models? (Choose three.)

options.A: Public cloud
options.B: Private cloud
options.C: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.D: Hybrid cloud

questions.explanation_es: Los modelos de despliegue de la nube (private, public, hybrid y community) describen dónde y por quién se opera la infraestructura, mientras que SaaS es un modelo de servicio, no de despliegue.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud deployment model is characterized by dedicating the infrastructure to a single organization, giving that organization a greater sense of control and security?

options.A: Public cloud
options.B: Hybrid cloud
options.C: Private cloud
options.D: Community cloud

questions.explanation_es: En una nube privada, la infraestructura se destina exclusivamente a una sola organización, lo que le otorga mayor sensación de control y seguridad, ya sea que se aloje internamente o la administre un tercero.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud deployment model is provisioned for a specific group of organizations that share common concerns, such as compliance, security requirements, or mission, without being dedicated to a single tenant?

options.A: Public cloud
options.B: Private cloud
options.C: Hybrid cloud
options.D: Community cloud

questions.explanation_es: La nube comunitaria (community cloud) está destinada a un grupo específico de organizaciones con intereses o requisitos compartidos, ofreciendo beneficios de seguridad similares a una nube privada junto con el modelo de costos compartidos de una nube pública.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Compared to a fully on-premises deployment, which of the following is a key advantage typically associated with cloud infrastructure?

options.A: It automatically guarantees compliance with all regulatory requirements
options.B: It removes any dependency on the cloud provider's own infrastructure
options.C: It offers a pay-as-you-go billing model that avoids large upfront capital expenses
options.D: It eliminates the need for any network connectivity to reach applications

questions.explanation_es: Uno de los principales atractivos de la nube es el modelo de pago por uso (pay-as-you-go), que convierte el gasto de capital (CapEx) en gasto operativo (OpEx) y evita grandes inversiones iniciales en infraestructura on-premises.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud service model gives a consumer the ability to use applications that run entirely on the provider's infrastructure, without managing servers, storage, or the underlying platform?

options.A: Backend as a Service (BaaS)
options.B: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.C: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.D: Software as a Service (SaaS)

questions.explanation_es: SaaS entrega aplicaciones completas alojadas y administradas por el proveedor de la nube; el consumidor solo utiliza la aplicación, sin gestionar servidores, almacenamiento, ni la plataforma subyacente.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which three characteristics does NIST associate with cloud services? (Choose three.)

options.A: Resource reservation
options.B: On-demand self-service
options.C: Resource pooling
options.D: Broad network access

questions.explanation_es: El autoservicio bajo demanda, el acceso amplio a la red y la agrupación de recursos (resource pooling) son características esenciales del NIST. La 'reservación de recursos' no forma parte de esa definición; en la nube los recursos se asignan dinámicamente, no se reservan de forma fija.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which type of private cloud deployment can be hosted off-premises by a third-party provider rather than inside the organization's own data center?

options.A: Community cloud
options.B: Internal private cloud
options.C: Hybrid cloud
options.D: Hosted private cloud

questions.explanation_es: La nube privada alojada (hosted private cloud) es operada por un tercero fuera de las instalaciones de la organización, a diferencia de la nube privada interna, que se ubica dentro del propio centro de datos de la empresa.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is a common consideration in favor of keeping an infrastructure on-premises rather than moving it to the cloud?

options.A: Faster time to market for new applications
options.B: A sense of near-unlimited scaling capacity
options.C: Regulatory requirements that mandate hosting data on-premises
options.D: Support for a pay-as-you-go consumption model

questions.explanation_es: Algunas organizaciones operan en entornos altamente regulados que exigen que ciertas aplicaciones y datos permanezcan alojados en sus propias instalaciones, lo cual es una consideración clave a favor de mantener la infraestructura on-premises.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between Stateful Switchover (SSO) and Nonstop Forwarding (NSF) on a Cisco device?

options.A: NSF requires SSO to be enabled and operational first
options.B: SSO requires NSF to be enabled before it can synchronize state
options.C: SSO and NSF are unrelated features that cannot be used together
options.D: NSF can operate fully independently, with no dependency on SSO

questions.explanation_es: NSF depende de que SSO esté habilitado, ya que SSO sincroniza el estado entre el supervisor activo y el standby, y NSF utiliza esa sincronización para seguir reenviando paquetes durante la conmutación del plano de control.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Which high-availability mechanism requires that neighboring routers support specific routing protocol extensions in order to preserve routes during a control-plane restart?

options.A: Graceful Restart (GR)
options.B: Nonstop Routing (NSR)
options.C: Stateful Switchover with Nonstop Forwarding (SSO/NSF)
options.D: Route Processor Redundancy (RPR)

questions.explanation_es: Graceful Restart se basa en extensiones específicas de cada protocolo de enrutamiento (por ejemplo, la capacidad de Graceful Restart en BGP o el Grace-LSA en OSPF) que deben ser soportadas por los routers vecinos para mantener las rutas mientras el router se reinicia.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: In HSRP, when two routers are configured with the same priority value, which factor breaks the tie to determine which router becomes active?

options.A: The router with the higher IP address configured on the HSRP interface
options.B: The router that has been up the longest
options.C: The router with the lowest configured hello timer
options.D: The router with the lowest interface IP address

questions.explanation_es: Cuando dos routers HSRP tienen la misma prioridad, el desempate se resuelve comparando las direcciones IP primarias configuradas en la interfaz; el router con la dirección IP más alta se convierte en el activo.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Which hardware redundancy mechanism allows a standby supervisor engine to immediately take over Layer 2 and Layer 3 forwarding state if the active supervisor engine fails?

options.A: Stateful Switchover (SSO)
options.B: Gateway Load Balancing Protocol (GLBP)
options.C: Nonstop Forwarding (NSF)
options.D: Virtual Switching System (VSS)

questions.explanation_es: SSO sincroniza continuamente el estado del plano de control y de reenvío entre el supervisor activo y el standby, permitiendo que el standby tome el control de inmediato ante una falla, sin necesidad de reiniciar el chasis.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the mandatory components of the Cisco SD-WAN architecture?

options.A: vAnalytics
options.B: vBond orchestrator
options.C: vManage NMS
options.D: vSmart controller

questions.explanation_es: Los componentes obligatorios de la solución SD-WAN de Cisco son el controlador vSmart (plano de control), los routers WAN edge (plano de datos), el orquestador vBond (plano de orquestación) y vManage (plano de gestión). vAnalytics es un componente opcional de análisis, no obligatorio.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: What type of permanent secure connection does a vSmart controller establish with each SD-WAN router (WAN edge) in the fabric?

options.A: A GRE tunnel protected by IPsec
options.B: A DTLS (or TLS) tunnel
options.C: An IPsec tunnel
options.D: A plain SSH session

questions.explanation_es: El controlador vSmart establece un túnel permanente DTLS (o TLS) con cada router WAN edge autenticado, y sobre ese túnel se establece la vecindad OMP para distribuir rutas y políticas.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN component serves as the single pane of glass for centralized configuration, monitoring, and management of the fabric?

options.A: vManage
options.B: Cisco DNA Center
options.C: vBond orchestrator
options.D: vSmart controller

questions.explanation_es: vManage es el componente del plano de gestión que ofrece una única interfaz centralizada (single pane of glass) para configurar, monitorear y solucionar problemas en toda la fabric de SD-WAN.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: What is the main function of the vBond orchestrator in the Cisco SD-WAN architecture?

options.A: To authenticate the vSmart controllers and the SD-WAN routers and orchestrate connectivity between them
options.B: To authenticate the vManage NMS and the SD-WAN routers and orchestrate connectivity between them
options.C: To advertise OMP routes between SD-WAN routers directly, bypassing vSmart
options.D: To authenticate the vSmart controllers and the vManage NMS and orchestrate connectivity between them

questions.explanation_es: El orquestador vBond autentica tanto a los controladores vSmart como a los routers SD-WAN cuando se incorporan a la fabric, y orquesta el establecimiento de la conectividad inicial entre ellos, actuando como punto de entrada al overlay.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which two router platform options can serve as WAN edge routers in a Cisco SD-WAN fabric? (Choose two.)

options.A: vEdge routers
options.B: cEdge routers (IOS XE SD-WAN)
options.C: vBond routers
options.D: Standalone ASR 1000 routers running only classic IOS XE

questions.explanation_es: Los routers WAN edge de Cisco SD-WAN pueden ser dispositivos vEdge (basados en el sistema operativo Viptela) o dispositivos cEdge, que ejecutan la funcionalidad SD-WAN sobre Cisco IOS XE.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: In a Cisco SD-WAN solution, which plane of operation is responsible for the automatic onboarding of new SD-WAN routers into the fabric?

options.A: Control plane
options.B: Management plane
options.C: Data plane
options.D: Orchestration plane

questions.explanation_es: El plano de orquestación, implementado por el vBond orchestrator, se encarga de la incorporación automática (zero-touch) de los routers SD-WAN a la fabric, autenticándolos y dirigiéndolos hacia los controladores correspondientes.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which statement about WAN edge router deployment options in Cisco SD-WAN is correct?

options.A: WAN edge routers require specialized ASICs that are not available in any virtualized form
options.B: WAN edge routers can only be deployed as dedicated physical appliances
options.C: WAN edge routers can be deployed as physical appliances or as virtual/software-based routers in a private or public cloud
options.D: Only the vSmart controller can be virtualized; WAN edge routers cannot

questions.explanation_es: Los routers WAN edge de Cisco SD-WAN están disponibles tanto como appliances físicos como en forma virtual (por ejemplo, sobre VMware ESXi, KVM, AWS o Azure), lo que brinda flexibilidad de despliegue en sitios físicos o en la nube.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN component provides the single pane of glass for the solution?

options.A: Cisco ISE
options.B: vSmart controller
options.C: Cisco DNA Center
options.D: vManage

questions.explanation_es: vManage centraliza la configuración, la contabilidad, el desempeño y la gestión de seguridad de toda la solución SD-WAN en una sola consola, funcionando como el panel único de administración.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: In an SD-WAN solution, which plane of operation is responsible for the central configuration and monitoring of the entire deployment?

options.A: Management plane
options.B: Data plane
options.C: Orchestration plane
options.D: Control plane

questions.explanation_es: El plano de gestión, representado por vManage, es responsable de la configuración centralizada, el monitoreo y la administración general del despliegue SD-WAN.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which SD-WAN component behaves similarly to a BGP route reflector, receiving routes from WAN edge routers, applying policy, and re-advertising them to other WAN edge routers?

options.A: vSmart controller
options.B: vBond orchestrator
options.C: vManage
options.D: WAN edge router

questions.explanation_es: El controlador vSmart recibe las rutas OMP de los routers WAN edge, les aplica las políticas centralizadas y luego las redistribuye a los demás routers del fabric, de forma análoga a como un route reflector de BGP redistribuye rutas entre sus clientes.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which statement best describes Cisco SD-WAN's independence from the underlying transport network?

options.A: SD-WAN requires a dedicated leased-line transport to function
options.B: SD-WAN builds a secure overlay over any transport, including MPLS, Internet, and cellular (4G/5G) circuits
options.C: SD-WAN can only operate over MPLS circuits to guarantee end-to-end QoS
options.D: SD-WAN can only operate over public Internet connections

questions.explanation_es: Una de las principales ventajas de SD-WAN es su independencia del transporte: construye un overlay seguro sobre cualquier tipo de underlay, ya sea MPLS, Internet, Metro Ethernet o enlaces celulares, sin depender de un único tipo de circuito.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN feature automates connectivity to workloads running in a public cloud (IaaS) when accessed from a data center or branch site?

options.A: Secure Direct Internet Access (DIA)
options.B: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
options.C: Cloud OnRamp for Colocation
options.D: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS

questions.explanation_es: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS automatiza la conectividad hacia cargas de trabajo alojadas en proveedores de nube pública (IaaS) como AWS o Azure, desplegando y conectando routers virtuales SD-WAN dentro de esas nubes.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN feature allows an administrator to choose the specific network path that traffic for a given SaaS application takes across the fabric?

options.A: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
options.B: Cloud OnRamp for Colocation
options.C: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS
options.D: Cloud OnRamp for PaaS

questions.explanation_es: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS monitorea el desempeño de los distintos caminos disponibles hacia una aplicación SaaS y permite elegir dinámicamente la mejor ruta para el tráfico de esa aplicación específica.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN feature automatically deploys WAN edge router instances in a public cloud so they become part of the SD-WAN overlay?

options.A: Cloud OnRamp for Colocation
options.B: Cloud OnRamp for PaaS
options.C: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS
options.D: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS

questions.explanation_es: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS despliega automáticamente instancias virtuales de routers WAN edge dentro del proveedor de nube pública, integrándolas al overlay de SD-WAN sin intervención manual extensa.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Why did Cisco choose VXLAN, rather than native LISP encapsulation, for the SD-Access data plane?

options.A: VXLAN eliminates the need for any control plane in the fabric
options.B: VXLAN can encapsulate Layer 2 frames, which native LISP encapsulation cannot
options.C: VXLAN provides built-in IPv6 support that native LISP encapsulation lacks
options.D: VXLAN uses a smaller header than LISP, reducing per-packet overhead

questions.explanation_es: VXLAN permite encapsular tramas de Capa 2 sobre una red de Capa 3, lo cual es necesario para el overlay de SD-Access, mientras que la encapsulación nativa de LISP no soporta el transporte de tramas Ethernet completas.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: How does the VXLAN header used by SD-Access differ from the standard VXLAN header defined in RFC 7348?

options.A: It removes the VNI field and replaces it with a LISP instance ID
options.B: It is a completely proprietary header unrelated to RFC 7348
options.C: It repurposes reserved header fields to carry a Group Policy ID used for scalable group tags
options.D: It doubles the header length to carry native IPv6 addressing

questions.explanation_es: SD-Access modifica el encabezado VXLAN estándar aprovechando campos reservados para transportar un Group Policy ID, lo que permite propagar las etiquetas de grupo escalable (SGT) junto con el tráfico encapsulado.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which protocol serves as the control plane for the Cisco SD-Access fabric?

options.A: PIM multicast
options.B: EVPN MP-BGP
options.C: Locator/ID Separation Protocol (LISP)
options.D: The VXLAN control plane defined in RFC 7348

questions.explanation_es: El plano de control de SD-Access se basa en LISP, que separa la identidad del endpoint (EID) de su ubicación en la red (RLOC) mediante un sistema de mapeo centralizado.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which field was added to the VXLAN header used by SD-Access to allow it to carry scalable group tags (SGT)?

options.A: Group Policy ID
options.B: LISP Instance ID field
options.C: VXLAN Network Identifier extension
options.D: TrustSec Session field

questions.explanation_es: El campo Group Policy ID, agregado al encabezado VXLAN mediante el uso de bits reservados, es el que permite transportar la etiqueta de grupo escalable (SGT) para aplicar políticas de TrustSec en el fabric.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which types of network environments was Cisco SD-Access primarily designed for?

options.A: Service provider WAN environments
options.B: Enterprise campus and branch environments
options.C: Data center environments
options.D: Public cloud provider backbones

questions.explanation_es: SD-Access fue diseñado específicamente para entornos de campus empresarial y sucursales, y no para centros de datos, proveedores de servicio ni redes WAN, que utilizan otras soluciones de fabric.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT considered a core physical or controller component of the Cisco SD-Access fabric architecture?

options.A: A dedicated next-generation firewall appliance
options.B: Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs)
options.C: Cisco DNA Center
options.D: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)

questions.explanation_es: Los componentes del fabric de SD-Access incluyen switches, routers, WLCs, access points y las appliances controladoras Cisco DNA Center e ISE. Un firewall dedicado no es un componente central de la arquitectura del fabric.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: In SD-Access terminology, what is the name given to the physical network of devices responsible for transporting packets between fabric nodes, independent of any overlay functionality?

options.A: Transit network
options.B: Overlay network
options.C: Fusion network
options.D: Underlay network

questions.explanation_es: El underlay es la red física subyacente cuya única función es transportar paquetes entre los dispositivos del fabric, sirviendo de base para que el overlay de SD-Access opere sobre ella.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which SD-Access architecture component forms part of the Layer 3 network that interconnects border nodes and edge nodes, without itself performing fabric overlay encapsulation?

options.A: Intermediate node
options.B: Fusion router
options.C: Extended node
options.D: Control-plane node

questions.explanation_es: Los nodos intermedios forman parte de la red de Capa 3 del underlay que interconecta a los nodos borde (border) y los nodos edge del fabric, encargándose únicamente del reenvío IP y no de las funciones de encapsulación del overlay.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: By default, what is the maximum number of hops the traceroute command will attempt before giving up on reaching the destination?
questions.explanation_es: Por defecto, el comando traceroute en Cisco IOS intenta hasta 30 saltos (TTL máximo) antes de detenerse si no alcanza el destino; 20 saltos es un valor incorrecto que suele usarse como distractor.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: When troubleshooting OSPF adjacency problems, debugging output is especially useful for identifying which three of the following issues? (Choose three.)

options.A: Mismatched MTU settings between neighbors
options.B: Mismatched subnet masks on the shared link
options.C: Contents of the IP routing table
options.D: Mismatched hello/dead timer values

questions.explanation_es: El debug de adyacencias OSPF (por ejemplo, debug ip ospf adj) es útil para detectar discordancias de MTU, de temporizadores hello/dead y de máscara de subred entre vecinos, ya que estas causan que la adyacencia no se forme o se quede en un estado como ExStart. Ver la tabla de enrutamiento se hace con show ip route, y la redistribución de BGP no está relacionada con la formación de adyacencias OSPF.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which debugging capability lets you restrict debug output to specific conditions, such as a particular interface or IP address, instead of flooding the console with every event of that type?

options.A: Extended ping
options.B: Flexible NetFlow sampling
options.C: SNMP polling
options.D: Conditional debugging

questions.explanation_es: La depuración condicional (conditional debugging) permite habilitar debugs de forma selectiva según una condición, como una interfaz o dirección IP específica, evitando saturar la CPU y la consola con mensajes de todos los eventos de ese tipo.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which command is used to discover the sequence of Layer 3 hops that packets take toward a destination?

options.A: show cdp neighbors
options.B: show ip route
options.C: traceroute
options.D: ping

questions.explanation_es: El comando traceroute envía paquetes con valores de TTL crecientes para descubrir, salto a salto, la ruta que siguen los paquetes hacia un destino determinado.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In an extended ping, which option helps identify the smallest MTU supported along the path to a destination?

options.A: Increasing the repeat count
options.B: Enabling the Record route option
options.C: Setting a data pattern of 0xABCD
options.D: Setting the Don't Fragment (DF) bit with an increasing packet size

questions.explanation_es: Al establecer el bit de No Fragmentar (DF) y aumentar progresivamente el tamaño del paquete en un ping extendido, un salto con una MTU menor descartará el paquete y devolverá un mensaje ICMP de fragmentación necesaria, lo que permite identificar la MTU más pequeña en la ruta.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In the SNMP framework, which component is responsible for controlling and monitoring the managed network hosts, typically by polling agents or receiving trap messages?

options.A: SNMP agent
options.B: SNMP MIB
options.C: SNMP manager
options.D: SNMP responder

questions.explanation_es: El gestor SNMP (SNMP manager), habitualmente un sistema de gestión de red (NMS), es el que controla y monitoriza la actividad de los hosts de red, recolectando datos mediante sondeo (polling) de los agentes o recibiendo mensajes trap de estos.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which command disables every active debug output on a router in one step?

options.A: no debug ip packet
options.B: undebug all
options.C: clear debug all
options.D: debug all disable

questions.explanation_es: El comando undebug all (equivalente a no debug all) desactiva de una sola vez todos los debugs que estén activos en el router.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In traceroute output, which single letter indicates that a probe was dropped because it was administratively filtered, such as by an access list?

options.A: N
options.B: Q
options.C: U
options.D: A

questions.explanation_es: La letra A en la salida de traceroute indica que el paquete fue administrativamente prohibido, es decir, filtrado por una lista de control de acceso (ACL) en algún salto del camino.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Why should round-trip times from ping or traceroute be interpreted cautiously when the destination is the router itself?

options.A: ICMP is disabled by default on router interfaces
options.B: The packet destined to the router is process-switched rather than hardware/CEF-switched
options.C: Ping cannot target a router's own interface address
options.D: Traceroute always rounds RTT values up to the nearest millisecond

questions.explanation_es: Cuando el destino es el propio router, el paquete se conmuta por proceso (process-switched) en lugar de usar CEF o conmutación por hardware, lo que añade una latencia adicional que no representa fielmente el rendimiento real del enlace.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: What is the default and maximum TTL value used by the traceroute command in Cisco IOS?
questions.explanation_es: El valor de TTL máximo (y por defecto) para el comando traceroute en Cisco IOS es 30 saltos.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which statement best describes an SNMP trap?

options.A: A request the manager repeats until the agent acknowledges receipt
options.B: A scheduled bulk transfer of every MIB variable on the agent
options.C: An unsolicited notification an agent sends to the manager when a defined event occurs
options.D: A message the manager sends to request a specific MIB object from the agent

questions.explanation_es: Un trap SNMP es una notificación no solicitada que el agente envía al gestor cuando ocurre un evento o condición definida, proporcionando una alerta casi en tiempo real sin esperar a ser consultado.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Why are SNMP informs generally considered more reliable than SNMP traps?

options.A: Informs are encrypted by default while traps are not
options.B: Informs can only be sent between devices running SNMPv3
options.C: Informs use TCP while traps use UDP
options.D: Informs are retransmitted until the manager acknowledges receipt, whereas traps are not

questions.explanation_es: A diferencia de los traps, los mensajes inform se reenvían repetidamente hasta que el gestor SNMP confirma su recepción, lo que los hace más fiables ante la pérdida de paquetes.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which two statements accurately describe the role of the SNMP agent? (Choose two.)

options.A: It requires SNMPv3 informs in order to operate at all
options.B: It resides on the managed device and maintains the local MIB data reported to the manager
options.C: It decides the polling interval used across the entire management domain
options.D: It can generate unsolicited trap messages toward the SNMP manager

questions.explanation_es: El agente SNMP reside en el dispositivo gestionado, mantiene los datos locales de la MIB y responde a las solicitudes Get/Set del gestor; además, puede generar mensajes trap no solicitados hacia el gestor cuando ocurre un evento relevante.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which two actions help minimize the performance impact of running debug ip packet on a production router? (Choose two.)

options.A: Apply an access list so only the traffic of interest is captured
options.B: Buffer the debug output and review it afterward with the logging buffer instead of sending it to the console
options.C: Run the debug command only from user EXEC mode
options.D: Increase the console baud rate before enabling the debug

questions.explanation_es: Para reducir el impacto de debug ip packet se recomienda usar una ACL que limite el tráfico capturado a lo estrictamente necesario y almacenar la salida en el buffer de logging para revisarla después, en lugar de enviarla directamente a la consola, que consume más recursos.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In traceroute output, which letter indicates that an intermediate router reported the destination network as unreachable?

options.A: Q
options.B: U
options.C: H
options.D: N

questions.explanation_es: La letra N en la salida de traceroute significa que la red de destino es inalcanzable (network unreachable), reportado por algún salto en el camino.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT something the ping command can determine about a remote host?

options.A: Whether any of the probes were lost
options.B: The measured round-trip delay to the host
options.C: The specific Layer 3 path taken to reach the host
options.D: Whether the host is currently reachable

questions.explanation_es: El comando ping no puede determinar la ruta que siguen los paquetes hacia el destino; para eso se utiliza traceroute, que muestra salto a salto el camino recorrido.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid SNMPv3 security level?

options.A: privNoAuth
options.B: authNoPriv
options.C: noAuthNoPriv
options.D: authPriv

questions.explanation_es: Los niveles de seguridad válidos en SNMPv3 son noAuthNoPriv, authNoPriv y authPriv. privNoAuth no existe como nivel de seguridad, ya que en SNMPv3 no se puede tener privacidad (cifrado) sin autenticación.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which syslog severity level indicates that the system itself has become unusable?

options.A: Alert (level 1)
options.B: Critical (level 2)
options.C: Error (level 3)
options.D: Emergency (level 0)

questions.explanation_es: El nivel de severidad 0 (Emergency) es el más grave e indica que el sistema es inestable o inutilizable.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which syslog severity level represents a normal but significant condition, worth noting but not indicating a problem?

options.A: Warning (level 4)
options.B: Error (level 3)
options.C: Informational (level 6)
options.D: Notification (level 5)

questions.explanation_es: El nivel de severidad 5 (Notification) indica una condición normal pero significativa, que merece atención aunque no represente un problema.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the standard elements that make up a syslog message?

options.A: Severity
options.B: Sequence number
options.C: Notification
options.D: Timestamp

questions.explanation_es: Notification es el nombre de un nivel de severidad, no un elemento del formato del mensaje de syslog; los elementos típicos son el número de secuencia, la marca de tiempo, la facility, la severidad y el mnemónico o descripción.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which element of a syslog message identifies the source or cause of the message, such as a hardware component, protocol, or software module?

options.A: Facility
options.B: Timestamp
options.C: Severity
options.D: Sequence number

questions.explanation_es: La facility indica el origen o la causa del mensaje de syslog, que puede ser un componente de hardware, un protocolo o un módulo del software del sistema.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: If logging is configured to severity level 2 (Critical), which severity levels will actually be logged? (Choose three.)

options.A: Critical
options.B: Emergency
options.C: Alert
options.D: Notification

questions.explanation_es: Al configurar el nivel de logging en 2 (Critical), IOS registra ese nivel y todos los más graves (numéricamente menores): Emergency (0), Alert (1) y Critical (2). Notification (5) es menos grave y no queda incluido.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: As of the ENCOR curriculum, what is the most recent version of traditional Cisco NetFlow (prior to Flexible NetFlow and IPFIX)?

options.A: Version 9
options.B: Version 7
options.C: Version 1
options.D: Version 5

questions.explanation_es: La versión más reciente del NetFlow tradicional de Cisco es la versión 9, que introdujo un formato de plantillas flexible que después sirvió de base para IPFIX.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which Cisco flow-monitoring technology allows the administrator to define custom key fields instead of being limited to a fixed set of match fields?

options.A: Flexible NetFlow
options.B: sFlow
options.C: IPFIX only
options.D: Traditional NetFlow

questions.explanation_es: Flexible NetFlow permite definir campos clave (key fields) personalizados para identificar los flujos, a diferencia del NetFlow tradicional, que está limitado a un conjunto fijo de campos.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which three components are used when building a Flexible NetFlow configuration? (Choose three.)

options.A: Top talkers report
options.B: Flow exporter
options.C: Flow sampler
options.D: Flow record

questions.explanation_es: Una configuración típica de Flexible NetFlow se apoya en el flow record (qué campos capturar), el flow monitor (que aplica el record y mantiene la caché de flujos) y el flow exporter (que envía los datos a un colector); el flow sampler es opcional y top talkers es solo un informe, no un componente de configuración.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the packet attributes traditionally used to define an IP flow in NetFlow?

options.A: Class of service
options.B: Source IP address
options.C: Destination MAC address
options.D: Destination port

questions.explanation_es: NetFlow define un flujo usando atributos de capa 3/4 como direcciones IP de origen y destino, puertos, protocolo, interfaz y CoS; la dirección MAC de destino es un campo de capa 2 que no forma parte de las claves tradicionales de NetFlow.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which Cisco technology can track a wide range of packet fields across Layer 2, IPv4, and IPv6 flows, going beyond what traditional NetFlow supports?

options.A: NetFlow version 9
options.B: Flexible NetFlow
options.C: sFlow
options.D: NetFlow version 10

questions.explanation_es: Flexible NetFlow puede rastrear una amplia variedad de campos en flujos de Capa 2, IPv4 e IPv6, superando las limitaciones del NetFlow tradicional.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an actual component of a Flexible NetFlow configuration?

options.A: Flow monitor
options.B: Flow session
options.C: Flow exporter
options.D: Flow record

questions.explanation_es: Flow session no es un componente real de Flexible NetFlow; los componentes son flow record, flow monitor, flow exporter y, opcionalmente, flow sampler.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which four elements can be part of a complete Flexible NetFlow configuration? (Choose four.)

options.A: Flow record
options.B: Flow sampler
options.C: Sequence number
options.D: Flow exporter

questions.explanation_es: Flow record, flow monitor, flow exporter y flow sampler son los componentes que se combinan para configurar Flexible NetFlow; el número de secuencia no tiene relación con esta configuración.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of ERSPAN?

options.A: Mirroring traffic from a port into a specific local VLAN
options.B: Mirroring traffic between two ports on the same switch
options.C: Mirroring traffic from a device and carrying it across a routed Layer 3 network to a remote destination
options.D: Mirroring traffic from a port to a destination port on a different local switch

questions.explanation_es: ERSPAN encapsula el tráfico espejado y lo transporta a través de una red enrutada de Capa 3 hasta un destino remoto, a diferencia de SPAN (mismo switch) y RSPAN (VLAN dedicada dentro de la misma red conmutada de Capa 2).

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: Which requirement applies specifically to a local SPAN session?

options.A: Source and destination must be connected through a dedicated VLAN
options.B: The destination port must be a Layer 3 routed interface
options.C: The source and destination ports must reside on the same switch
options.D: Traffic must be encapsulated in GRE before reaching the destination port

questions.explanation_es: En una sesión de SPAN local, tanto los puertos origen como el puerto destino deben estar en el mismo switch; para monitorear entre switches distintos se necesitan RSPAN o ERSPAN.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: How does an ERSPAN source session deliver mirrored traffic to the ERSPAN destination session?

options.A: By encapsulating it in a routable GRE tunnel sent across the IP network
options.B: By copying it into a reserved 802.1Q VLAN tag
options.C: By forwarding it unmodified over a crossover cable
options.D: By flooding it out every trunk port in the source VLAN

questions.explanation_es: ERSPAN encapsula el tráfico capturado en paquetes GRE enrutables, lo que permite enviarlo a través de una red IP hacia la sesión de destino ERSPAN, sin necesidad de conectividad Capa 2 directa.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: What advantage does ERSPAN offer compared to a basic local SPAN session?

options.A: It requires no configuration on the source switch
options.B: It only works with EtherChannel source interfaces
options.C: It eliminates the need for a destination analyzer altogether
options.D: It can monitor traffic from multiple ports or VLANs and deliver it to one or more destinations across a routed network

questions.explanation_es: ERSPAN aporta la flexibilidad de monitorizar tráfico de uno o varios puertos o VLANs y entregarlo a uno o más destinos, incluso a través de una red enrutada, algo que el SPAN local no permite.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: Which SPAN implementation requires dedicating a special VLAN to carry the mirrored traffic between switches?

options.A: VSPAN
options.B: Local SPAN
options.C: ERSPAN
options.D: RSPAN

questions.explanation_es: RSPAN transporta el tráfico espejado como tráfico de Capa 2 no enrutable sobre una VLAN dedicada y específica para esa sesión, propagada por todos los switches participantes.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: Which command displays the session type, the source ports for each monitored direction, and the destination port of a SPAN/RSPAN session?

options.A: show logging
options.B: show span status
options.C: show monitor
options.D: show flow monitor

questions.explanation_es: El comando show monitor muestra el tipo de sesión (local, RSPAN, ERSPAN), los puertos origen y la dirección monitoreada, así como el puerto o sesión destino.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Which four metrics can IP SLA be configured to monitor? (Choose four.)

options.A: Packet loss
options.B: Jitter
options.C: Voice quality scores
options.D: SNMP trap contents

questions.explanation_es: IP SLA puede medir retardo (delay), jitter, pérdida de paquetes y puntuaciones de calidad de voz (por ejemplo, MOS), entre otras métricas de rendimiento; no está diseñado para monitorear mensajes de syslog ni el contenido de traps SNMP.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the ICMP echo operation in IP SLA?

options.A: To synchronize the clock between the source and the responder
options.B: To measure end-to-end response time and verify basic IP connectivity to a target
options.C: To negotiate which flow exporter format will be used
options.D: To distribute routing updates between IP SLA-enabled routers

questions.explanation_es: La operación ICMP echo de IP SLA envía sondas para medir el tiempo de respuesta extremo a extremo hacia un dispositivo y también permite verificar la conectividad IP básica hacia ese destino.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Is an IP SLA responder mandatory for IP SLA operations to function?

options.A: True, without a responder no IP SLA operation can run
options.B: True, but only for UDP-based operations
options.C: False, a responder is only used to enable SNMP traps
options.D: False, IP SLA can run without a responder, though the responder improves measurement accuracy

questions.explanation_es: El responder de IP SLA no es obligatorio para que las operaciones funcionen, pero cuando está habilitado en el dispositivo destino permite obtener mediciones más precisas, como la marca de tiempo de llegada, sin necesitar sondas dedicadas adicionales.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Can multiple IP SLA operations, each performing a different measurement or test, be configured simultaneously on the same device?

options.A: Yes, but only if all operations use the same protocol
options.B: No, multiple operations require a dedicated IP SLA responder appliance
options.C: No, a device can run only one IP SLA operation at a time
options.D: Yes, a single device can run multiple independent IP SLA instances at once

questions.explanation_es: Un mismo dispositivo puede tener configuradas múltiples instancias de IP SLA simultáneamente, cada una realizando una operación o verificación diferente, identificadas por su propio número de operación.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Which three of the following can be verified or measured using IP SLA? (Choose three.)

options.A: Syslog message delivery
options.B: Website or server response time and availability
options.C: One-way or round-trip delay
options.D: Packet loss

questions.explanation_es: IP SLA puede reportar pérdida de paquetes, tiempo de respuesta y disponibilidad de servidores o sitios web, y retardo; no tiene relación con la entrega de mensajes de syslog.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which three of the following are top-level sections of the Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center dashboard? (Choose three.)

options.A: Assurance
options.B: Plan
options.C: Provision
options.D: Operate

questions.explanation_es: Assurance, Design y Provision son secciones reales del panel de Cisco DNA Center (junto con Policy, que no aparece entre estas opciones); Plan y Operate no son secciones propias de la plataforma.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: True or false: Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance can monitor only routers and switches.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: Cisco DNA Center Assurance también monitoriza controladores inalámbricos, puntos de acceso y dispositivos cliente, no solo routers y switches.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which two capabilities help Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance simplify network troubleshooting and diagnostics? (Choose two.)

options.A: Using streaming telemetry to gain real-time insight from devices
options.B: Adding Plug and Play onboarding for new devices
options.C: Using open APIs to integrate with other platforms for extra context
options.D: Simplifying the provisioning workflow for new devices

questions.explanation_es: La telemetría en streaming aporta visibilidad casi en tiempo real del estado de los dispositivos, y las API abiertas permiten integrar información contextual de otras plataformas; Plug and Play y la simplificación del aprovisionamiento están relacionados con otras funciones de DNA Center, no directamente con el diagnóstico de Assurance.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center section translates business intent into network policies, such as access control, traffic routing, and QoS, applied consistently across the wired and wireless infrastructure?

options.A: Design
options.B: Policy
options.C: Provision
options.D: Assurance

questions.explanation_es: La sección Policy de Cisco DNA Center traduce la intención de negocio en políticas de red (control de acceso, enrutamiento de tráfico, QoS) que se aplican de forma consistente en toda la infraestructura cableada e inalámbrica.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which four sections make up the Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center dashboard workflow? (Choose four.)

options.A: Design
options.B: Policy
options.C: Assurance
options.D: Automation

questions.explanation_es: Los cuatro bloques principales del flujo de trabajo de Cisco DNA Center son Design, Policy, Provision y Assurance; Automation no es uno de esos cuatro apartados con ese nombre.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which capability of Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance allows context-aware baselining, capturing how the relationship between metrics changes as network conditions evolve?

options.A: The Network Health and Client Health dashboards
options.B: Device 360 / Client 360
options.C: Machine learning algorithms
options.D: User-defined network segmentation

questions.explanation_es: Los algoritmos de machine learning de Cisco DNA Center Assurance permiten un baselining sensible al contexto, actualizando de forma continua la relación óptima entre métricas a medida que cambian las condiciones de la red.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance feature provides a historical, timeline-based view of a specific device or client, including topology, throughput, and latency at different points in time?

options.A: Device 360 / Client 360
options.B: Network Health dashboard
options.C: Path Trace only
options.D: User-Defined Network

questions.explanation_es: Device 360/Client 360 ofrece una vista basada en línea de tiempo de un dispositivo o cliente concreto, mostrando información como topología, rendimiento y latencia en distintos momentos.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which transport protocol does NETCONF rely on to secure communication between client and server?

options.A: TLS over TCP
options.B: Plain HTTP
options.C: IPsec
options.D: SSH

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF utiliza SSH como transporte entre el cliente y el servidor, lo que garantiza confidencialidad, integridad y autenticidad en la comunicación.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: In the context of RESTCONF, what do the CRUD operations represent?

options.A: Commit, Rollback, Undo, Deploy
options.B: Create, Read, Update, Delete
options.C: Connect, Retrieve, Upload, Disconnect
options.D: Configure, Report, Update, Diagnose

questions.explanation_es: CRUD hace referencia a las operaciones Create, Read, Update y Delete que RESTCONF aplica sobre un almacén de datos conceptual definido por modelos YANG.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which NETCONF operation is used to load all or part of a configuration into a specified target configuration datastore?

options.A: get
options.B: get-config
options.C: edit-config
options.D: copy-config

questions.explanation_es: La operación edit-config carga la totalidad o una parte de una configuración especificada en el almacén de configuración de destino indicado.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: What is the purpose of the candidate configuration datastore in NETCONF?

options.A: It permanently replaces the running configuration as soon as it is created
options.B: It stores a read-only copy of the device's startup configuration, kept for comparison purposes rather than as an editable workspace for changes destined for the running configuration
options.C: It provides a temporary workspace holding a copy of the configuration that can be edited before being committed
options.D: It stores only the factory-default configuration

questions.explanation_es: El almacén de configuración candidate ofrece un espacio de trabajo temporal donde se guarda una copia de la configuración que puede modificarse y luego confirmarse (commit) para aplicarla a la configuración en ejecución.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: When a NETCONF client connects to a NETCONF server, what type of session is established between them?

options.A: An unauthenticated TCP session
options.B: A TLS session over UDP
options.C: An SSH session
options.D: An unencrypted Telnet session

questions.explanation_es: El cliente NETCONF establece una sesión SSH con el servidor NETCONF, sobre la cual se intercambian los mensajes RPC codificados en XML.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which command verifies that the software processes required for NETCONF and RESTCONF, such as nginx and confd, are running on a Cisco IOS XE device?

options.A: show platform software yang-management process
options.B: show netconf-yang sessions details
options.C: show netconf-yang sessions
options.D: show netconf-yang statistics

questions.explanation_es: El comando show platform software yang-management process permite verificar el estado de los procesos de software (como nginx y confd) necesarios para que NETCONF y RESTCONF funcionen correctamente.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: True or false: NETCONF relies on a Remote Procedure Call (RPC) based mechanism for communication between client and server.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF se basa en un mecanismo de llamada a procedimiento remoto (RPC) codificado en XML para la comunicación entre el cliente y el servidor.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: True or false: RESTCONF is based on JSON and SSH.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: RESTCONF se basa en JSON y HTTP (no SSH); es NETCONF-YANG el que utiliza un modelo de transporte basado en SSH.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Among the Cisco IOS password types, which one provides the weakest protection because it is trivially reversible with widely available tools?

options.A: Type 9 (scrypt)
options.B: Type 7 (Vigenere-style obfuscation)
options.C: Type 8 (PBKDF2 with SHA-256)
options.D: Type 5 (MD5 hash)

questions.explanation_es: El tipo 7 usa una ofuscación reversible (estilo Vigenere) que puede desencriptarse fácilmente con herramientas públicas, mientras que los tipos 8 y 9 usan funciones de hash robustas y el tipo 5 usa MD5, más resistente que el tipo 7.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Which encryption type is applied to plaintext passwords already present in the running configuration when an administrator issues the service password-encryption command?

options.A: Type 9
options.B: Type 7
options.C: Type 5
options.D: Type 0

questions.explanation_es: El comando service password-encryption aplica un cifrado tipo 7 (reversible) a las contraseñas en texto claro almacenadas en la configuración.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: What correctly describes the difference between the "login" and "login local" line configuration commands? (Choose two.)

options.A: "login" enables authentication using only a configured line password
options.B: "login local" enables authentication against locally configured usernames and passwords
options.C: "login local" enables authentication using only a configured line password
options.D: "login" enables authentication against a locally configured username database

questions.explanation_es: El comando "login" solicita únicamente la contraseña de línea configurada, mientras que "login local" exige un usuario y contraseña validados contra la base de datos local del dispositivo.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: A user authenticates to a router and lands at privilege level 0 instead of the usual user EXEC level. Which of the following commands can this user still execute? (Choose two.)

options.A: disable
options.B: configure terminal
options.C: show running-config
options.D: logout

questions.explanation_es: El nivel de privilegio 0 solo habilita un conjunto mínimo de comandos (disable, enable, exit, help y logout); comandos como show running-config o configure terminal requieren niveles de privilegio más altos.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: An administrator wants the vty lines on a router to accept only inbound SSH sessions and reject Telnet entirely. Which two configuration elements accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: transport input all under line vty configuration
options.B: An extended ACL permitting only TCP port 22, applied inbound with access-class on the vty lines
options.C: transport input ssh under line vty configuration
options.D: transport output ssh under line vty configuration

questions.explanation_es: "transport input ssh" impide que se acepten conexiones Telnet en las líneas vty, y una ACL extendida aplicada con access-class que permita solo el puerto TCP 22 añade una restricción adicional por origen.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: What is the first practical step recommended to secure user EXEC access on a Cisco IOS device before deploying a centralized AAA solution?

options.A: Configure passwords for local and remote CLI sessions
options.B: Deploy a TACACS+ server for authentication
options.C: Raise the enable secret to privilege level 15
options.D: Enable SSH version 2 on all vty lines

questions.explanation_es: Antes de implementar AAA centralizado, el paso básico inicial es configurar contraseñas locales para las sesiones CLI locales (consola) y remotas (vty), estableciendo una línea base de seguridad.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Which line configuration command is typically applied under the auxiliary line to prevent remote administrative access through a dial-up modem?

options.A: login local
options.B: transport input none
options.C: exec-timeout 0 0
options.D: no exec

questions.explanation_es: El comando "no exec" bajo "line aux 0" deshabilita la posibilidad de iniciar una sesión EXEC a través del puerto auxiliar, evitando el acceso remoto vía módem.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Why can a device running only SSHv1 not establish a management session with a peer configured to support only SSHv2?

options.A: SSHv1 requires a RADIUS server for key exchange that SSHv2 does not support
options.B: SSHv2 works only with certificate-based authentication
options.C: SSHv2 uses TCP port 23 while SSHv1 uses port 22
options.D: SSHv1 and SSHv2 are incompatible protocol versions and cannot interoperate with each other

questions.explanation_es: SSHv2 introdujo cambios de protocolo que lo hacen incompatible con SSHv1; un dispositivo limitado a SSHv1 no puede negociar una sesión con un peer configurado exclusivamente para SSHv2.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: True or false: Configuring "aaa authorization exec default group ISE-TACACS+ if-authenticated" automatically forces EXEC authorization on the console line as well as on the vty lines.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: Por defecto, la autorización EXEC del método "default" no se aplica automáticamente a la línea de consola; se requiere el comando adicional "aaa authorization console" para forzarla también allí.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which AAA function is primarily responsible for logging the specific commands a user executes on a network device?

options.A: Accounting
options.B: Authentication
options.C: Auditing
options.D: Authorization

questions.explanation_es: La función de accounting (contabilidad) registra la actividad de la sesión, incluidos los comandos ejecutados, para fines de auditoría y generación de reportes.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which protocol is generally preferred for controlling and auditing administrative access to network devices, due to its command-level authorization granularity?

options.A: Telnet
options.B: SSHv2
options.C: RADIUS
options.D: TACACS+

questions.explanation_es: TACACS+ separa autenticación, autorización y contabilidad y permite autorizar comandos individuales, lo que lo hace más adecuado que RADIUS para el control de acceso administrativo a dispositivos.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Over which port and transport protocol does a TACACS+ client communicate with a TACACS+ server?

options.A: UDP port 49
options.B: TCP port 389
options.C: TCP port 49
options.D: UDP port 1812

questions.explanation_es: TACACS+ utiliza el puerto TCP 49 para la comunicación entre el cliente (dispositivo de red) y el servidor TACACS+.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: What is a key advantage of using a centralized AAA server (RADIUS or TACACS+) instead of configuring local authentication independently on every network device?

options.A: It eliminates the need to ever configure a local fallback account
options.B: It provides standardized, scalable authentication management across many devices
options.C: It removes the requirement for encrypted management protocols like SSH
options.D: It allows console ports to bypass authentication entirely

questions.explanation_es: Centralizar la autenticación en un servidor AAA aporta escalabilidad y consistencia en los métodos de autenticación en todos los dispositivos, evitando configurar cada uno de forma individual.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT typically presented as a benefit of deploying AAA on network devices?

options.A: Complete elimination of the need for any local user accounts
options.B: Standardized authentication using RADIUS or TACACS+
options.C: Scalability across many devices
options.D: Increased flexibility and control over access configuration

questions.explanation_es: Aun con AAA desplegado, se recomienda mantener una cuenta local como respaldo por si el servidor AAA no está disponible, por lo que AAA no elimina por completo la necesidad de usuarios locales.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: In the commonly used implementation of RADIUS, which UDP port is designated for accounting traffic?

options.A: UDP port 1645
options.B: UDP port 1646
options.C: UDP port 1813
options.D: UDP port 1812

questions.explanation_es: La implementación estándar de RADIUS usa el puerto UDP 1813 para el tráfico de accounting, mientras que el 1812 se usa para autenticación/autorización.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which global configuration command must be entered before any AAA authentication, authorization, or accounting statements can take effect on a Cisco IOS device?

options.A: aaa authorization network default
options.B: aaa new-model
options.C: aaa authentication login default
options.D: aaa accounting exec default

questions.explanation_es: "aaa new-model" habilita el subsistema AAA en el dispositivo; sin este comando, las demás sentencias de autenticación, autorización y contabilidad no surten efecto.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which types of devices can act as a TACACS+ network access server (NAS) requesting services from a TACACS+ daemon?

options.A: Routers, switches, and access points
options.B: Only switches
options.C: Only wireless access points
options.D: Only routers

questions.explanation_es: Cualquier dispositivo de red que actúe como cliente TACACS+ (router, switch o access point) puede funcionar como NAS que solicita servicios de autenticación al servidor TACACS+.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: An administrator created a AAA authentication method list named "list1" and wants a specific vty line to use it instead of the default list. Which line configuration command accomplishes this?

options.A: login authentication list1
options.B: aaa authentication login list1
options.C: aaa new-model list1
options.D: aaa authorization exec list1

questions.explanation_es: El comando "login authentication list1", aplicado en modo de configuración de línea, vincula esa línea al método de autenticación personalizado llamado "list1".

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: After entering "tacacs server MYSERVER" in IOS 15.x, which subcommand specifies the server's IPv4 address (for example, 10.10.10.10)?

options.A: aaa tacacs 10.10.10.10
options.C: address ipv4 10.10.10.10
options.D: ip tacacs-server 10.10.10.10

questions.explanation_es: Dentro del submodo de configuración del servidor TACACS+, el comando "address ipv4 10.10.10.10" especifica la dirección IP del servidor.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which interface configuration command applies an IPv4 access list to filter traffic on that interface?

options.A: ip access-class {number|name} {in|out}
options.B: access-list apply {number|name} {in|out}
options.C: ip access-group {number|name} {in|out}
options.D: ip access-list {number|name} {in|out}

questions.explanation_es: "ip access-group" es el comando de interfaz usado para aplicar una ACL numerada o nombrada al tráfico entrante o saliente de esa interfaz.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: What is a practical advantage of using named ACLs instead of numbered ACLs?

options.A: Named ACLs allow individual entries to be added, removed, or resequenced without recreating the entire list
options.B: Named ACLs can only be applied to VLAN interfaces
options.C: Named ACLs bypass the implicit deny at the end of the list
options.D: Named ACLs support wildcard masks while numbered ACLs do not

questions.explanation_es: Las ACL con nombre permiten editar entradas individuales (añadir, eliminar o reordenar por número de secuencia) sin tener que recrear toda la lista, a diferencia de una ACL numerada clásica.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which command is used to apply a port ACL (PACL) filtering IPv4 traffic to a Layer 2 switchport interface?

options.A: ip access-class access-list-name {in|out}
options.B: vlan filter access-list-name vlan-list
options.C: mac access-group access-list-name in
options.D: ip access-group access-list-name {in|out}

questions.explanation_es: Al igual que en un router, "ip access-group" se usa para aplicar la ACL IPv4 a la interfaz de Capa 2 del switch; para filtrado por dirección MAC se emplea en cambio "mac access-group".

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: How many access lists can be applied to a single interface, per protocol and per direction (inbound or outbound)?

options.A: Up to two
options.B: Up to four
options.C: An unlimited number
options.D: Only one

questions.explanation_es: Por diseño de Cisco IOS, solo se puede aplicar una ACL por protocolo y por dirección en cada interfaz.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which command applies a previously defined VLAN access-map to a specific VLAN or set of VLANs, creating a VACL?

options.A: vlan access-map map-name
options.B: ip access-group access-list-name {in|out}
options.C: vlan filter map-name vlan-list
options.D: ip access-class access-list-name {in|out}

questions.explanation_es: "vlan filter map-name vlan-list" asocia un VLAN access-map ya definido a una VLAN específica, un rango de VLANs, o una lista separada por comas.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: To which of the following can a port ACL (PACL) be applied? (Choose two.)

options.A: A Layer 2 access switchport
options.B: A VLAN interface (SVI)
options.C: A Layer 3 routed subinterface
options.D: A trunk port

questions.explanation_es: Las PACL se aplican a puertos de Capa 2 de un switch, incluyendo puertos de acceso y puertos trunk; no se aplican a SVIs (eso corresponde a las VACL) ni a subinterfaces enrutadas de Capa 3.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which two types of access lists are specifically designed to filter traffic in a Layer 2 switching environment, as opposed to a routed Layer 3 interface?

options.A: Extended numbered ACLs
options.B: Port ACLs (PACLs)
options.C: Standard numbered ACLs
options.D: VLAN ACLs (VACLs)

questions.explanation_es: Las PACL se aplican a puertos de Capa 2 y las VACL a VLANs; las ACL estándar y extendidas clásicas están orientadas a interfaces enrutadas de Capa 3.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Once an incoming packet matches an access control entry (ACE) within an ACL, what happens next?

options.A: The packet is queued until all ACEs have been checked for a possible better match
options.B: The permit or deny action for that ACE is applied, and evaluation of the remaining ACEs stops
options.C: Evaluation always continues through every remaining ACE regardless of the match
options.D: Only deny actions stop further evaluation; permit actions continue checking subsequent ACEs

questions.explanation_es: El procesamiento de una ACL es secuencial y de primera coincidencia: en cuanto se encuentra una ACE que coincide, se aplica su acción (permit o deny) y se detiene la evaluación del resto de la lista.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: A VLAN ACL's (VACL) VLAN list can reference all of the following EXCEPT:

options.A: Individual Layer 2 switchports
options.B: A range of VLANs
options.C: A single VLAN
options.D: A comma-separated list of multiple VLANs

questions.explanation_es: La lista de VLANs de una VACL puede especificar una VLAN individual, un rango, o una lista separada por comas, pero no puede hacer referencia directa a puertos de Capa 2 individuales.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which Cisco IOS feature was developed specifically to protect a router's route processor (RP) or CPU from being overwhelmed by excessive or malicious traffic?

options.A: Control Plane Policing (CoPP)
options.B: AAA
options.C: Zone-Based Firewall (ZBFW)
options.D: Standard ACLs applied inbound on every interface

questions.explanation_es: CoPP fue diseñado específicamente para proteger el plano de control (la CPU/RP) de un router o switch frente a tráfico excesivo o de tipo DoS, priorizando el tráfico de control importante.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: True or false: Control Plane Policing (CoPP) can apply separate service policies for traffic entering and traffic leaving the control plane.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: CoPP admite políticas de servicio tanto de entrada como de salida sobre el plano de control, aunque en la práctica la política de entrada es la que se utiliza con más frecuencia.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: What is the primary reason an administrator would implement CoPP on a Cisco IOS router?

options.A: To translate private addresses destined to the control plane
options.B: To encrypt management traffic destined to the router itself
options.C: To load-balance traffic across multiple WAN links
options.D: To protect the route processor from unnecessary or denial-of-service traffic while prioritizing legitimate control-plane traffic

questions.explanation_es: El objetivo principal de CoPP es blindar al RP frente a tráfico innecesario o de denegación de servicio, dando prioridad al tráfico de control y gestión legítimo.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which command displays whether a CoPP service policy has been successfully applied to the control plane, along with its matching statistics?

options.A: show access-lists control-plane
options.B: show ip interface control-plane
options.C: show running-config | include copp
options.D: show policy-map control-plane

questions.explanation_es: "show policy-map control-plane" muestra la política de servicio aplicada al plano de control, junto con las estadísticas de coincidencia de cada clase.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: In a CoPP configuration, which construct groups previously defined ACLs together in order to classify traffic before a policy action is applied?

options.A: A route map
options.B: A class map
options.C: A service map
options.D: The ACL itself, applied directly with ip access-group

questions.explanation_es: El class-map utiliza las ACL ya creadas para clasificar el tráfico según protocolos, direcciones u otros criterios, antes de que la policy-map defina la acción a aplicar sobre cada clase.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which command attaches a previously defined CoPP policy map to the control plane so it actually takes effect?

options.A: policy-map
options.B: ip access-group policy-name control-plane
options.C: service-policy {input|output} policy-name, entered in control-plane configuration mode
options.D: class-map
