questions.explanation_es: El comando "service-policy", aplicado dentro del modo de configuración de control-plane, es el que vincula la policy-map al plano de control para que la política surta efecto.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: True or false: CoPP is configured and enforced on a per-interface basis, similar to a standard interface ACL.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: A diferencia de una ACL de interfaz, CoPP se aplica de forma global al dispositivo, ya que protege el plano de control del equipo en su conjunto y no una interfaz en particular.

questions.name: Seguridad de REST API
questions.question: In an SDN architecture, which API type does a controller use to expose network state and control to business applications and orchestration services running above it?

options.A: A dedicated management-only API separate from REST
options.B: East-West API
options.C: Northbound API
options.D: Southbound API

questions.explanation_es: La API northbound es la que expone el controlador SDN hacia las aplicaciones y servicios de orquestación que se ejecutan por encima de él, permitiendo que esas aplicaciones consuman los datos y funciones de red del controlador.

questions.name: Seguridad de REST API
questions.question: When Cisco ISE integrates with Cisco DNA Center to secure their communication channel, what type of credential does ISE present as its identity?

options.A: A Kerberos ticket
options.B: A self-signed PGP key
options.C: A shared pre-shared key (PSK) only, without certificates
options.D: An X.509 v3 certificate

questions.explanation_es: ISE utiliza un certificado de identidad X.509 v3 para autenticarse y asegurar la comunicación con Cisco DNA Center, en lugar de depender únicamente de credenciales compartidas.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: What is the name of the overarching Cisco security architecture framework used to design secure solutions across different places in the network (PINs)?

options.A: Cisco Validated Design (CVD)
options.B: Cisco Threat Response
options.C: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics
options.D: Cisco SAFE

questions.explanation_es: Cisco SAFE es el marco de referencia de arquitectura de seguridad que Cisco define para diseñar soluciones seguras en los distintos lugares de la red (PINs).

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which three of the following are recognized "Places in the Network" (PINs) in the Cisco SAFE framework?

options.A: Data center
options.B: Internet
options.C: Campus
options.D: Edge

questions.explanation_es: Campus, centro de datos y edge son PINs reconocidos dentro de Cisco SAFE; "Internet" no es en sí un PIN, sino la red externa con la que se conecta el PIN de Edge.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which three of the following are secure domains defined within the Cisco SAFE framework?

options.A: Threat defense
options.B: Compliance
options.C: Segmentation
options.D: Segregation

questions.explanation_es: Threat defense, segmentación y compliance son dominios seguros reconocidos por Cisco SAFE; "segregación" no es un dominio oficial del framework.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco organization is dedicated to threat intelligence research, tracking threats across endpoints, networks, cloud, web, and email?

options.A: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.B: The standalone Cisco TRAC team
options.C: Cisco Talos
options.D: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Talos es la organización de inteligencia de amenazas de Cisco, formada por la unión de varios equipos de investigación de seguridad, incluido el antiguo equipo TRAC.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: What best describes Cisco Secure Malware Analytics (formerly Threat Grid)?

options.A: The organization that produces Cisco's global threat intelligence feeds
options.B: The overarching Cisco security architecture framework
options.C: A NetFlow-based network traffic analytics tool
options.D: A sandboxing solution that performs static and dynamic (behavioral) analysis of files to determine whether they are malicious

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics ejecuta archivos sospechosos en un entorno sandbox controlado y realiza análisis estático y dinámico (de comportamiento) para determinar si son maliciosos.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco solution primarily relies on NetFlow telemetry from the network infrastructure to detect anomalous or malicious behavior?

options.A: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.B: Cisco Secure Web Appliance
options.C: Cisco Talos
options.D: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Secure Network Analytics (antes Stealthwatch) se apoya en telemetría NetFlow generada por la infraestructura de red para detectar comportamientos anómalos o maliciosos.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which two of the following discovery protocols are commonly disabled on infrastructure devices as a hardening best practice, since they advertise device and topology information? (Choose two.)

options.A: Zone-Based Firewall (ZBFW)
options.B: Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP)
options.C: Control Plane Policing (CoPP)
options.D: Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP)

questions.explanation_es: CDP y LLDP anuncian información del dispositivo y la topología en el segmento local; deshabilitarlos en interfaces no confiables reduce la superficie de reconocimiento disponible para un atacante.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Within the Cisco SAFE PIN model, in which PIN are the majority of an organization's critical information assets typically located?

options.A: WAN
options.B: Data center
options.C: Edge
options.D: Branch

questions.explanation_es: El centro de datos es el PIN donde normalmente reside la mayoría de los activos de información críticos de una organización, lo que lo convierte en un objetivo prioritario de protección.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco SAFE PIN is generally considered the highest-risk location because it is the primary point where public Internet traffic enters and corporate traffic exits?

options.A: Campus
options.B: WAN
options.C: Branch
options.D: Edge

questions.explanation_es: El PIN de Edge se considera el de mayor riesgo porque es el principal punto de ingreso de tráfico público de Internet y de salida del tráfico corporativo hacia Internet.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco security solution is agentless and relies on machine learning and behavioral modeling of network telemetry to detect emerging threats?

options.A: Cisco Umbrella
options.B: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect)
options.C: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.D: Cisco AMP

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Secure Network Analytics no requiere agentes en los endpoints; analiza telemetría de red mediante aprendizaje automático y modelado de comportamiento para detectar amenazas emergentes.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco SAFE secure domain focuses on the global detection and aggregation of emerging malware intelligence?

options.A: Security intelligence
options.B: Segmentation
options.C: Threat defense
options.D: Compliance

questions.explanation_es: El dominio de inteligencia de seguridad se centra en la detección global y la agregación de información sobre malware emergente y otras amenazas.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco cloud security solution blocks connections to malware, ransomware, phishing sites, and botnet command-and-control infrastructure at the DNS and IP layers, before a session is even established?

options.A: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect)
options.B: Cisco Umbrella
options.C: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.D: Cisco AMP

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Umbrella actúa en la capa DNS/IP para bloquear el acceso a dominios e IPs asociados a malware, ransomware, phishing y botnets antes de que se establezca la conexión.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: True or false: Cisco pxGrid functionality requires Cisco ISE, since ISE hosts the pxGrid controller that shares contextual data with integrated security platforms.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: pxGrid depende de Cisco ISE, que actúa como el controlador pxGrid encargado de compartir información contextual con las plataformas de seguridad integradas.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: Which EAP method supports EAP chaining, allowing both machine and user credentials to be validated within a single authentication exchange?

options.A: EAP-GTC
options.B: EAP-TTLS
options.C: PEAP
options.D: EAP-FAST

questions.explanation_es: EAP-FAST admite el encadenamiento de EAP (EAP chaining), que permite validar las credenciales de máquina y de usuario dentro del mismo intercambio de autenticación.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: Which authentication mechanism is typically used as a fallback for devices that cannot perform 802.1X supplicant-based authentication?

options.A: Central Web Authentication
options.B: TACACS+ authorization
options.C: EAP-TLS
options.D: MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB)

questions.explanation_es: MAB (MAC Authentication Bypass) se usa como mecanismo de respaldo para autenticar dispositivos que no cuentan con un suplicante 802.1X, basándose en su dirección MAC.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: Which type of web authentication supports advanced services such as client provisioning, posture assessment, acceptable-use-policy acknowledgment, and self- or device-registration?

options.A: Guest Web Authentication configured directly on the switch
options.B: Open Authentication with WebAuth passthrough
options.C: Central Web Authentication
options.D: Local Web Authentication

questions.explanation_es: La autenticación web centralizada (Central Web Authentication), gestionada desde ISE, habilita servicios avanzados como el aprovisionamiento del cliente, la evaluación de postura, el reconocimiento de políticas de uso aceptable y el autorregistro de dispositivos.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: True or false: A Security Group Tag (SGT) is propagated all the way down into the endpoint's own network stack or software.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: El SGT se asigna e inserta en la red de acceso (switches, routers, firewalls), pero no se propaga hasta el software o la pila de red del propio endpoint.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: Which three phases make up the Cisco TrustSec model?

options.A: Distribution
options.B: Classification
options.C: Propagation
options.D: Enforcement

questions.explanation_es: TrustSec se compone de tres fases: clasificación (asignación del SGT), propagación (difusión del SGT hasta el punto de aplicación) y enforcement (control del tráfico según el SGT).

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: What is the name of Cisco's software-defined segmentation technology that dynamically groups endpoints into logical Security Groups instead of relying on IP addresses or VLANs?

options.A: Cisco SD-Access Fabric
options.B: Cisco TrustSec
options.C: Cisco DNA Center Assurance
options.D: Cisco ACI

questions.explanation_es: Cisco TrustSec es la solución de segmentación definida por software que agrupa dinámicamente a los endpoints en grupos de seguridad lógicos basados en contexto de negocio, no en direcciones IP o VLANs.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: In the Cisco TrustSec model, which phase is responsible for actually restricting or permitting traffic based on the SGT carried by a packet?

options.A: Assignment
options.B: Enforcement
options.C: Classification
options.D: Propagation

questions.explanation_es: La fase de enforcement (aplicación) es la que controla el tráfico basándose en la etiqueta SGT, normalmente en un switch, router o firewall.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: In the Cisco TrustSec model, during which phase are users or devices assigned to a Security Group as they connect to the network?

options.A: Classification
options.B: Propagation
options.C: Enforcement
options.D: Assignment

questions.explanation_es: La fase de clasificación es cuando se asigna un usuario o dispositivo a un grupo de seguridad al conectarse a la red, ya sea de forma dinámica (tras la autenticación) o estática.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: True or false: MACsec encryption is enabled on a per-link (per-port) basis rather than applied globally across an entire switch.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: MACsec se habilita puerto por puerto (enlace por enlace), aprovechando el soporte de hardware (ASIC) de cada puerto, y no de forma global en todo el switch.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: In Cisco TrustSec, which SGT classification method downloads the tag dynamically from ISE as part of an 802.1X, MAB, or WebAuth authentication exchange?

options.A: Static assignment
options.B: Dynamic assignment
options.C: SXP-based mapping
options.D: Inline tagging

questions.explanation_es: En la asignación dinámica, el SGT se descarga desde ISE como parte del resultado de la autenticación 802.1x, MAB o WebAuth, sin necesidad de configuración manual en el dispositivo.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: True or false: "Downlink" MACsec refers to encrypting the link between two switches in the network core.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: El MACsec "downlink" cifra el enlace entre un endpoint y el switch de acceso; el cifrado entre switches se conoce como MACsec "uplink" o de infraestructura.

questions.name: Hypervisor tipo 1 y 2
questions.question: Which type of hypervisor is most commonly deployed in enterprise production data centers?

options.A: A nested hypervisor that runs inside another virtual machine
options.B: A Type 2 hypervisor, because it integrates directly with the desktop operating system
options.C: A hosted hypervisor that runs as an application on top of Windows Server
options.D: A Type 1 (bare-metal) hypervisor, because it runs directly on the physical hardware

questions.explanation_es: El hipervisor tipo 1 (bare-metal) se instala directamente sobre el hardware físico sin necesitar un sistema operativo anfitrión, lo que le da mejor rendimiento y estabilidad; por eso es el más usado en despliegues de producción empresarial.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: Which statement best defines a virtual machine (VM)?

options.A: A software emulation of a physical server that never includes an operating system
options.B: An isolated file-system namespace used only to package application dependencies
options.C: A lightweight process that shares the host kernel and never emulates hardware
options.D: A software emulation of a physical server, including its own guest operating system

questions.explanation_es: Una VM es la emulación por software de un servidor físico completo, que incluye su propio sistema operativo invitado, a diferencia de un contenedor, que solo empaqueta la aplicación y sus dependencias sobre el kernel del host.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: In the context of server virtualization, what does the term "consolidation ratio" describe?

options.A: The ratio of physical NICs to virtual NICs configured on a hypervisor
options.B: The number of virtual CPUs allocated to a single virtual machine
options.C: The ratio of virtual machines running on a single physical host compared to that host
options.D: The percentage of a VM's allocated memory that is actively in use

questions.explanation_es: La relación de consolidación (consolidation ratio) indica cuántas máquinas virtuales se ejecutan sobre un mismo servidor físico, reflejando cuánto se está aprovechando el hardware gracias a la virtualización.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: From the perspective of the hypervisor, how is a virtual machine's virtual disk typically represented?

options.A: As a reserved block of host RAM used for the VM's storage I/O
options.B: As one or more files stored on the storage attached to the hypervisor host
options.C: As a remote iSCSI target that bypasses the hypervisor's file system entirely
options.D: As a dedicated physical disk partition mapped directly to the VM through raw device mapping, bypassing the hypervisor's own file system for that VM's storage I/O

questions.explanation_es: El hipervisor representa el disco de una VM como uno o varios archivos (por ejemplo, VMDK o VHD) ubicados en el almacenamiento conectado al host, lo que facilita operaciones como clonado, snapshots y migración en caliente.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: Which statement best describes a virtual switch (vSwitch)?

options.A: A software-based Layer 2 switch that lets VMs communicate with each other and with the physical network
options.B: A clustering technology that binds several physical switches into one logical switching system
options.C: A software-based Layer 3 device that routes traffic between VM subnets
options.D: A dedicated hardware NIC that offloads all switching decisions from the hypervisor's CPU

questions.explanation_es: Un vSwitch es un switch de Capa 2 implementado en software dentro del hipervisor; permite que las VMs se comuniquen entre sí y con la red física a través de las NIC físicas (pNIC) del servidor.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: True or false: A virtualized server can have only a single virtual switch instance running on it at any given time.

options.A: True, because the hypervisor kernel exposes only one virtual switch port group per host
options.B: True, because a physical NIC can only ever be bound to one vSwitch across the whole data center
options.C: False, a virtualized server can run multiple vSwitches, although traffic cannot flow directly between them
options.D: False, but only when the host is running a Type 2 hypervisor instead of Type 1

questions.explanation_es: Un servidor virtualizado puede tener varios vSwitches configurados al mismo tiempo, pero el tráfico no puede pasar directamente de un vSwitch a otro dentro del mismo host; para lograrlo se necesitaría un dispositivo intermedio, como un firewall virtual, que conecte ambos segmentos.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: Do containerized workloads sharing the same host still need a virtual switch or virtual bridge to communicate with each other and with the outside network?

options.A: No, containers attach directly to the host's physical NIC and bypass any virtual switching layer
options.B: No, containers exchange traffic only through shared memory segments, so no switching layer is involved
options.C: Yes, containers rely on a virtual switch or bridge, such as Docker's default bridge, much like VMs rely on a vSwitch
options.D: Yes, but only when the containers are being managed by a Kubernetes orchestrator

questions.explanation_es: Al igual que las VMs, los contenedores dependen de un switch o puente virtual (por ejemplo, el bridge docker0) para comunicarse entre sí dentro del mismo nodo y con el exterior, ya que el motor de contenedores no conecta sus interfaces directamente al NIC físico.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which statement best describes Python's reputation among network engineers learning automation?

options.A: Python code must be compiled into a platform-specific binary before it can run.
options.B: Python requires manual memory management similar to C, making it hard for beginners.
options.C: Python enforces strict static typing that must be declared for every variable.
options.D: Python is widely considered one of the more approachable languages for newcomers to programming.

questions.explanation_es: Python es ampliamente considerado uno de los lenguajes más accesibles para principiantes gracias a su sintaxis simple y legible, por lo que se usa mucho en automatización de redes. Las otras opciones describen características que no aplican a Python, como la gestión manual de memoria, la compilación obligatoria a binario o el tipado estático estricto.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: In Python, what are two valid uses of a set of three consecutive quotation marks (''' or """)? (Choose two.)

options.A: To represent a logical OR comparison
options.B: To mark the beginning of a multi-line string
options.C: To declare a new function definition
options.D: To mark the end of a multi-line string

questions.explanation_es: Las triples comillas se usan para abrir y cerrar cadenas de texto que abarcan varias líneas, como los docstrings o strings multilínea. No se usan para definir funciones, ya que para eso se emplea la palabra clave "def", ni para representar un OR lógico, que se escribe con la palabra "or".

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which of the following code snippets correctly represents a Python dictionary?

options.A: print(dnac_devices)
options.B: [users[root|Jason|Jamie|Luke]]
options.C: def dnac_login(host, username, password): return requests.get(url)
options.D: { "host": "sandboxdnac.cisco.com", "port": 443, "username": "devnetuser", "password": "Cisco123!" }

questions.explanation_es: Un diccionario en Python se define con llaves y pares clave-valor separados por comas, tal como se ve en la opción A. La opción B no corresponde a una sintaxis válida de Python, la opción C es la definición de una función y la opción D es simplemente una llamada a la función print().

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which two of the following represent the definition or invocation of a Python function? (Choose two.)

options.A: def dnac_login(host, username, password): return requests.get(url).json()
options.B: dnac = { "host": "sandboxdnac.cisco.com", "port": 443 }
options.C: print(dnac_devices)
options.D: [users[root|Jason|Jamie|Luke]]

questions.explanation_es: La opción C define una función usando la palabra clave "def", y la opción D invoca la función incorporada print(). La opción A es un diccionario y la opción B no es sintaxis válida de Python.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: Which of the following data samples is formatted as valid JSON?

options.A: <users><user><name>root</name></user></users>
options.B: [users[root|Jason|Jamie|Luke]]
options.C: root Jason Jamie Luke
options.D: { "user": "root", "father": "Jason", "mother": "Jamie", "friend": "Luke" }

questions.explanation_es: JSON representa los datos como pares clave-valor encerrados entre llaves, tal como se muestra en la opción A. La opción B es XML porque usa etiquetas, la opción C es texto plano sin estructura y la opción D no corresponde a ningún formato de datos estándar.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: Which two elements are core building blocks used to structure a YANG data model? (Choose two.)

options.A: Leaf
options.B: Class
options.C: Method
options.D: Container

questions.explanation_es: YANG organiza los datos usando "container" para agrupar nodos relacionados y "leaf" para representar un valor de dato individual. "Class" y "method" son conceptos de programación orientada a objetos y no forman parte de las construcciones propias del modelado YANG.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: When authenticating to obtain a token from the Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) API, which HTTP request method is required?

options.A: GET
options.B: PUT
options.C: POST
options.D: PATCH

questions.explanation_es: La API de autenticación de Catalyst Center requiere un método POST hacia el endpoint de token, ya que se está creando una nueva sesión de autenticación, y no simplemente consultando datos existentes como haría un GET.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: What authentication method does the Cisco Catalyst Center Token API rely on to issue an authentication token?

options.A: An unauthenticated open API call
options.B: A pre-shared X-Auth-Token header sent before any login request
options.C: SSH public-key authentication
options.D: Basic authentication with a base64-encoded username and password

questions.explanation_es: La API de token de Catalyst Center usa autenticación básica HTTP, en la que el usuario y la contraseña se codifican en base64 y se envían en la solicitud inicial para obtener el token que se usará en las llamadas posteriores.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which statement accurately compares CLI-based configuration to automation tools when managing a large number of network devices?

options.A: The CLI and automation tools apply configuration through completely incompatible protocols that can never coexist.
options.B: Configuring devices individually through the CLI scales efficiently as the device count grows.
options.C: Automation tools cannot interact with any device that is also managed through the CLI.
options.D: CLI-based configuration becomes slower and more error-prone as the number of devices increases, which is why automation tools are preferred at scale.

questions.explanation_es: A medida que crece el número de dispositivos, configurarlos uno por uno mediante la CLI se vuelve lento y propenso a errores humanos; por eso se prefieren las herramientas de automatización, ya sean basadas en agente o sin agente, para operar a gran escala.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which three of the following automation tools operate in an agentless fashion, without needing persistent software installed on the managed device? (Choose three.)

options.A: Chef
options.B: Salt SSH
options.C: Ansible
options.D: Puppet Bolt

questions.explanation_es: Ansible, Puppet Bolt y Salt SSH se comunican por SSH sin necesidad de instalar un agente permanente en el dispositivo administrado, a diferencia de Chef, que requiere el agente chef-client instalado localmente en cada nodo.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which two of the following are native components used to structure an Ansible automation project? (Choose two.)

options.A: Recipes
options.B: Playbooks
options.C: Manifests
options.D: Tasks

questions.explanation_es: Ansible organiza la automatización en playbooks, archivos YAML que describen el estado deseado, compuestos a su vez por tasks individuales. Los manifiestos pertenecen a Puppet y las recipes pertenecen a Chef.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which two configuration management tools are implemented primarily in Python? (Choose two.)

options.A: Ansible
options.B: Chef
options.C: SaltStack
options.D: Puppet

questions.explanation_es: Ansible y SaltStack están escritos principalmente en Python, mientras que Chef y Puppet están construidos sobre Ruby.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Chef recipes and cookbooks are primarily written using which programming language?

options.A: Tcl
options.B: Go
options.C: Ruby
options.D: Python

questions.explanation_es: Chef utiliza un lenguaje de dominio específico basado en Ruby para escribir sus recipes y cookbooks, a diferencia de Ansible o SaltStack, que están basados en Python.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the syntax used in an Ansible playbook file?

options.A: Playbooks use a proprietary binary format that cannot be edited as plain text.
options.B: Playbooks are written in YAML and conventionally begin with three dashes (---) at the top of the file.
options.C: Playbooks are written in JSON and require curly braces to enclose every task.
options.D: Playbooks must be compiled into XML before Ansible can parse them.

questions.explanation_es: Los playbooks de Ansible se escriben en formato YAML y, por convención, comienzan con tres guiones (---) al inicio del archivo para indicar el comienzo de un documento YAML.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which command correctly runs an Ansible playbook named ConfigureInterface.yaml?

options.A: ansible-run ConfigureInterface.yaml
options.B: play ansible-book ConfigureInterface.yaml
options.C: ansible ConfigureInterface.yaml
options.D: ansible-playbook ConfigureInterface.yaml

questions.explanation_es: El comando ansible-playbook es el que se utiliza para ejecutar un archivo de playbook en YAML; el comando ansible simple se usa para ejecutar módulos ad hoc individuales, no playbooks completos.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which two of the following automation tools rely on a persistent agent installed on the managed device in their standard mode of operation? (Choose two.)

options.A: Ansible
options.B: SaltStack (Salt minion)
options.C: Chef
options.D: Salt SSH

questions.explanation_es: En su modo estándar, SaltStack utiliza un agente llamado minion instalado en cada dispositivo administrado, y Chef requiere el agente chef-client. En cambio, Ansible y Salt SSH operan sin agente, comunicándose directamente por SSH.

questions.name: Métodos HTTP
questions.question: In the context of RESTful APIs, what does the acronym CRUD represent?

options.A: Create, Receive, Upload, Delete
options.B: Create, Restore, Upload, Download
options.C: Create, Read, Update, Delete
options.D: Create, Retrieve, Update, Delete

questions.explanation_es: CRUD corresponde a las cuatro operaciones básicas de manejo de datos: Create, Read, Update y Delete, que típicamente se mapean a los métodos HTTP POST, GET, PUT o PATCH, y DELETE respectivamente.

questions.name: Métodos HTTP
questions.question: Which HTTP status code indicates that a request failed because the client was not authenticated?
questions.explanation_es: El código 401 Unauthorized indica que la solicitud no incluyó credenciales de autenticación válidas. El 400 corresponde a una solicitud mal formada, el 404 a un recurso no encontrado y el 201 a la creación exitosa de un recurso.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Cisco IOS platforms that support Python allow scripts to run in which two general modes?

options.A: Sandbox mode and privileged mode
options.B: Interactive mode and non-interactive (scripted) mode
options.C: Kernel mode and user mode
options.D: Compiled mode and bytecode mode

questions.explanation_es: Cisco admite Python en modo interactivo, donde los comandos se ejecutan uno a uno desde un intérprete, y en modo no interactivo o por script, donde se ejecuta un archivo completo de código. Las demás opciones no son términos que describan los modos de Python en plataformas Cisco.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: In Python, what does the type() function return when called on a variable?

options.A: The number of bytes the variable occupies on disk
options.B: The data type (class) of the object referenced by the variable
options.C: The current memory address of the variable
options.D: A Boolean indicating whether the variable has been initialized

questions.explanation_es: La función type() devuelve el tipo de dato, o clase, del objeto al que hace referencia la variable, por ejemplo str, int, list o dict. No indica la dirección de memoria, el tamaño en disco ni si la variable fue inicializada.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: True or false: Python is a suitable language for scripting network troubleshooting tasks and for reacting to network events.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Python es adecuado para tareas de solución de problemas de red, uso general, acciones basadas en eventos y otras operaciones de DevOps, gracias a su sintaxis sencilla y a su amplio soporte de bibliotecas.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which built-in Python data structure stores data as key/value pairs, allowing a value to be looked up by its key?

options.A: Tuple
options.B: List
options.C: String
options.D: Dictionary

questions.explanation_es: El diccionario es la estructura de datos de Python que asocia claves con valores y permite buscar un valor a partir de su clave. Las cadenas, las listas y las tuplas no funcionan como pares clave/valor.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: True or false: The term 'native' or 'onboard' Python refers to a Python interpreter that runs directly on the switching platform itself, such as on a Catalyst 9000 switch.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: Python nativo, u onboard, se refiere al intérprete de Python instalado directamente en la plataforma de switching, como el Catalyst 9300, sin necesidad de un sistema externo.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which of the following is generally NOT cited as an advantage of Python 3.x when compared with Python 2.x?

options.A: Simpler syntax that is easier to learn
options.B: Broader support on newer Cisco platforms
options.C: Compatibility with tools such as virtualenv
options.D: A larger base of legacy third-party libraries built up over time

questions.explanation_es: Durante mucho tiempo, Python 2.x contó con una base de bibliotecas de terceros más madura y extensa acumulada a lo largo de los años, mientras que Python 3.x se destacaba por su sintaxis más simple, su mejor soporte en plataformas nuevas y su compatibilidad con herramientas como virtualenv.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which command is used to enable Guest Shell so that the Python interpreter can be used on a Cisco IOS XE device?

options.A: guestshell run python
options.B: guestshell enable
options.C: iox enable
options.D: guestshell run

questions.explanation_es: El comando guestshell enable habilita el contenedor Guest Shell en un dispositivo Cisco IOS XE, lo que permite ejecutar el intérprete de Python dentro de ese entorno.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: True or false: In Python's try/except construct, the else clause defines a block of code that runs only if no exception was raised in the try block.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: La cláusula else en el manejo de excepciones de Python define un bloque de código que se ejecuta únicamente si no se produjo ningún error dentro del bloque try.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: Which three protocols form the core of the model-driven programmability stack used to interact with network device data models?

options.A: SNMP, Telnet, and SSH
options.B: NETCONF, RESTCONF, and gRPC
options.C: FTP, TFTP, and SCP
options.D: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF, RESTCONF y gRPC son los tres protocolos principales de la pila de programabilidad basada en modelos, utilizados para transportar datos de configuración y de estado hacia y desde los modelos de datos del dispositivo.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: Between XML and JSON, which data format is generally considered quicker and easier for humans to write by hand?

options.A: Both are equally easy to write
options.B: XML
options.C: Neither format is meant to be written by hand
options.D: JSON

questions.explanation_es: JSON se considera más rápido y sencillo de escribir a mano que XML, ya que su sintaxis es más compacta y tiene menos elementos repetitivos, como las etiquetas de apertura y cierre.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: Within the model-driven programmability stack, which layer is responsible for defining the syntax, semantics, and constraints of the data being exchanged?

options.A: Transport layer
options.B: Data models
options.C: Protocol layer
options.D: Encoding layer

questions.explanation_es: Los modelos de datos son la base de las APIs: definen la sintaxis, la semántica y las restricciones asociadas con su uso, independientemente del protocolo de transporte o del formato de codificación empleado.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: True or false: JSON is generally simpler and more compact than XML, which makes it a good fit for object-oriented systems.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: JSON es más simple y compacto que XML, resulta más fácil de analizar gracias a esa simplicidad, y se adapta mejor a los sistemas orientados a objetos.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: What does the very first line of a well-formed XML document typically represent?

options.A: The XML declaration
options.B: The root element
options.C: A comment block
options.D: A child element

questions.explanation_es: La primera línea de un documento XML es la declaración XML, que especifica la versión de XML utilizada, por ejemplo 1.0, y la codificación de caracteres empleada, por ejemplo ISO-8859-1.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: True or false: Similar to XML, a JSON document uses closing end tags to mark the end of each element.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: A diferencia de XML, JSON es jerárquico y contiene valores anidados, pero no utiliza etiquetas de cierre; los elementos se delimitan con llaves, corchetes y comas en lugar de etiquetas.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: In JSON syntax, which character is used to separate one key/value pair from the next within an object?

options.A: Semicolon
options.B: Colon
options.C: Pipe
options.D: Comma

questions.explanation_es: La coma se utiliza para separar cada par clave/valor dentro de un objeto JSON, mientras que los dos puntos separan la clave de su valor correspondiente dentro del mismo par.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: True or false: Omitting a required comma between key/value pairs in a JSON document will cause a parsing error.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: JSON exige una sintaxis estricta; la ausencia de una coma separadora entre pares clave/valor produce un error al analizar el documento en la aplicación.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: Which set of protocols does YANG rely on to actually transport configuration and operational data to and from a device?

options.A: SNMP and Syslog
options.B: NETCONF, RESTCONF, and gRPC
options.C: BGP only
options.D: HTTP and FTP

questions.explanation_es: YANG en sí mismo es solo un lenguaje de modelado; se apoya en protocolos como NETCONF, RESTCONF y gRPC para transportar realmente los datos de configuración y de estado operativo hacia y desde el dispositivo.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: Which YANG node type represents a sequence of simple leaf values of the same type, without any additional internal structure?

options.A: Leaf-list node
options.B: List node
options.C: Container node
options.D: Leaf node

questions.explanation_es: El nodo leaf-list contiene una secuencia de valores simples del mismo tipo, a diferencia del nodo leaf, que almacena un único valor.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: Why is SNMP generally not considered one of the modern data-model components of the network programmability stack, unlike YANG?

options.A: Because it does not distinguish between configuration data and operational (state) data
options.B: Because it cannot operate over an IP network
options.C: Because it requires a proprietary Cisco-only agent
options.D: Because it only supports read operations and no writes at all

questions.explanation_es: SNMP no distingue claramente entre datos de configuración y datos operativos, lo cual es una de las razones por las que no se lo considera un modelo de datos moderno dentro del enfoque programático de red, a diferencia de YANG.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: YANG models that are vendor-neutral and maintained by bodies such as the IETF or the OpenConfig working group are best classified as which type of model?

options.A: Deviation models
options.B: Native (vendor-specific) models
options.C: Industry standard-based (common) models
options.D: Notification models

questions.explanation_es: Los modelos estándar de la industria, o comunes, son independientes del proveedor y de la plataforma, y provienen de grupos de trabajo como el IETF y OpenConfig, a diferencia de los modelos nativos, que son específicos de cada fabricante.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: Which YANG node type defines a sequence of entries, each of which is uniquely identified by one or more key leaves?

options.A: List node
options.B: Leaf-list node
options.C: Container node
options.D: Leaf node

questions.explanation_es: El nodo list define una secuencia de entradas, cada una identificada de forma única mediante una o más hojas clave, lo que permite representar tablas o colecciones de elementos estructurados.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: True or false: NETCONF can serve as the transport medium that carries YANG-modeled configuration and operational data between a network device and a management application.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF puede actuar como el medio de transporte que mueve los datos de configuración y operativos modelados con YANG entre un dispositivo de red y una aplicación de gestión.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: What type of API allows you to build bidirectional integrations that exchange contextual information between Cisco DNA Center (Catalyst Center) and external third-party systems?

options.A: REST-based integration adapter APIs
options.B: SNMP trap listeners
options.C: Syslog forwarding APIs
options.D: CLI screen-scraping scripts

questions.explanation_es: Las APIs de adaptador de integración basadas en REST permiten construir interfaces bidireccionales que intercambian información contextual entre Cisco DNA Center (Catalyst Center) y sistemas externos de terceros.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which Cisco DNA Center capability is responsible for managing software images and the associated image update repository across network devices?

options.A: Network Hierarchy
options.B: Path Trace
options.C: Command Runner
options.D: Software Image Management (SWIM)

questions.explanation_es: Software Image Management, o SWIM, es la funcionalidad de Cisco DNA Center encargada de administrar las imágenes de software y el repositorio de actualizaciones de los dispositivos de red.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: True or false: Cisco DNA Center supports integrating with third-party ecosystem domains such as IT Service Management (ITSM) and IP Address Management (IPAM).

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Cisco DNA Center permite la integración con diversos dominios del ecosistema de terceros, como la gestión de servicios de TI (ITSM) y la gestión de direcciones IP (IPAM), además de la generación de reportes.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the typical subdomains found under the 'Know Your Network' request path in the Cisco DNA Center API?

options.A: Devices
options.B: Environment
options.C: Sites
options.D: Clients

questions.explanation_es: Environment no es uno de los subdominios típicos de la ruta Know Your Network en la API de Cisco DNA Center; entre los subdominios habituales se encuentran Devices, Clients y Sites.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which of the following is a common use case for the Cisco vManage API?

options.A: Compiling router firmware from source code
options.B: Issuing digital certificates for end-user laptops
options.C: Attaching a configuration template to a device
options.D: Replacing the physical power supply of a switch

questions.explanation_es: Adjuntar una plantilla de configuración a un dispositivo es un caso de uso habitual de la API de Cisco vManage, junto con el monitoreo del estado de los dispositivos y la consulta y agregación de estadísticas.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: True or false: The RESTful Cisco DNA Center API lets you use standard HTTP verbs such as GET, PUT, POST, and DELETE, combined with JSON, to discover and control the network.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: La API RESTful de Cisco DNA Center permite utilizar los verbos HTTP estándar GET, PUT, POST y DELETE junto con la sintaxis JSON para descubrir y controlar la red.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: Which HTTP method is used to submit a username and password when authenticating to the Cisco DNA Center or vManage REST API?

options.A: DELETE
options.B: POST
options.C: GET
options.D: PUT

questions.explanation_es: El método HTTP POST se utiliza para enviar el nombre de usuario y la contraseña al autenticarse contra la API REST de Cisco DNA Center o vManage.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: Which HTTP status code returned by Cisco DNA Center indicates that the requested resource could not be found?
questions.explanation_es: El código de estado HTTP 404 indica que el recurso solicitado no fue encontrado en el servidor de Cisco DNA Center.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: True or false: When an error is caused by a problem on the server side, a REST API typically returns a status code in the 5xx range.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Cuando el error se origina en el servidor, la API REST normalmente devuelve un código de estado en el rango 5xx, indicando que el servidor no pudo completar una solicitud aparentemente válida.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: Which HTTP status code should you expect to receive after a successful authentication attempt against the Cisco vManage or DNA Center API?
questions.explanation_es: Una autenticación exitosa contra la API de Cisco vManage o DNA Center debería devolver un código de estado 200 (OK), confirmando que la solicitud se procesó correctamente.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: True or false: An HTTP 202 status code means the server accepted the request but still needs to perform additional processing before it is fully completed.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: El código HTTP 202 (Accepted) significa que el servidor aceptó la solicitud correctamente, pero todavía necesita realizar acciones adicionales para completarla.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: True or false: An HTTP 201 status code means that the server was unable to fulfill the request because it was unavailable.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: El código HTTP 201 indica que un recurso fue creado exitosamente, no que el servidor esté no disponible; ese significado corresponde al código 503 (Service Unavailable).

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: Which component of the EEM architecture is responsible for determining when a defined EEM event has actually occurred?

options.A: Event detectors
options.B: Policy director
options.C: Tcl interpreter
options.D: Applet compiler

questions.explanation_es: Los detectores de eventos son el componente de la arquitectura de EEM encargado de determinar cuándo ha ocurrido un evento definido, para luego disparar la política o el applet correspondiente.

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: Which command lets you observe, on the CLI, the actions being executed while an EEM applet is running?

options.A: debug event manager action cli
options.B: show event manager policy active
options.C: debug ip eem
options.D: event manager run applet-name

questions.explanation_es: El comando debug event manager action cli permite visualizar en la CLI las acciones que se están ejecutando mientras corre un applet de EEM.

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: Which EEM architecture component acts as the bridge between the Cisco IOS subsystems used by event detectors and the policies that respond to them?

options.A: Tcl script
options.B: EEM detector
options.C: EEM server
options.D: EEM applet

questions.explanation_es: El servidor de EEM actúa como puente entre los subsistemas de Cisco IOS utilizados por los detectores de eventos y las políticas que responden a dichos eventos.

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: Which EEM event detector generates an event specifically when an administrator manually triggers a policy using the 'event manager run' CLI command?

options.A: None event detector
options.B: Application event detector
options.C: CLI event detector
options.D: Syslog event detector

questions.explanation_es: El detector de eventos none genera un evento cuando el comando event manager run se ejecuta manualmente en la CLI para disparar una política de EEM.

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: True or false: An EEM applet can be used to provide a temporary automated workaround for a problem while its root cause is still being investigated.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Un applet de EEM puede servir como una solución temporal automatizada mientras se investiga la causa raíz de un problema, por ejemplo reiniciando automáticamente una interfaz cuando se detecta una condición intermitente.

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: Which command manually triggers an EEM applet to run immediately from the CLI?

options.A: more flash:applet-name
options.B: event manager run applet-name
options.C: event manager action cli
options.D: event none applet-name

questions.explanation_es: El comando event manager run applet-name se utiliza para ejecutar manualmente un applet de EEM desde la línea de comandos.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which of the following best describes how CoPP determines whether traffic is allowed to reach a router's control plane?

options.A: It is enabled by default on all Cisco platforms and requires no configuration
options.B: It relies on the forwarding ASIC to silently drop any packet addressed to the router's own IP address
options.C: It filters traffic using a standard ACL applied inbound on every physical interface
options.D: It applies a policy-map, attached to the control-plane interface, that classifies and rate-limits or drops traffic destined to the route processor's CPU

questions.explanation_es: CoPP se implementa aplicando un policy-map a la interfaz virtual control-plane, que clasifica el tráfico destinado a la CPU del route processor y le aplica una acción (permitir, limitar la tasa, o descartar) según la clase a la que pertenezca.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: In a TACACS+ deployment, what does 'authorization' typically control that plain authentication does not?

options.A: Whether a user's identity is verified against a username and password
options.B: Which encryption algorithm is used to protect the TACACS+ packet body
options.C: Which specific commands or services an already-authenticated user is permitted to use
options.D: How long the TCP session to the TACACS+ server stays open

questions.explanation_es: La autenticación solo verifica la identidad del usuario; la autorización es un paso posterior y separado que determina qué comandos o servicios específicos puede usar ese usuario ya autenticado.

questions.name: NGFW/FMC/AVC
questions.question: In Cisco Firepower/FTD, what is the primary role of Application Visibility and Control (AVC)?

options.A: Identifying and classifying traffic by the actual application generating it, regardless of port number, so policy can be applied based on that application
options.B: Automatically patching vulnerable applications running on protected hosts
options.C: Load-balancing traffic across multiple FTD appliances in a cluster
options.D: Encrypting all traffic that passes through the firewall using TLS 1.3

questions.explanation_es: AVC identifica y clasifica el tráfico según la aplicación real que lo genera, independientemente del número de puerto, permitiendo aplicar políticas basadas en esa aplicación en lugar de solo en IP/puerto.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which type of ACL can filter traffic based on source IP, destination IP, protocol, and Layer 4 port number in a single statement?

options.A: Reflexive ACL only
options.B: VLAN ACL only
options.C: Standard ACL
options.D: Extended ACL

questions.explanation_es: Una ACL extendida puede filtrar por dirección IP origen, dirección IP destino, protocolo y puerto de Capa 4 en una sola sentencia; una ACL estándar solo puede filtrar por dirección IP origen.

questions.name: Seguridad de REST API
questions.question: What is the main purpose of using OAuth 2.0 access tokens with a short expiration time?

options.A: To reduce the impact of a leaked token, since it becomes unusable once it expires
options.B: To increase the amount of data that can be transmitted per API call
options.C: To eliminate the need for HTTPS on API endpoints
options.D: To allow a single token to authenticate an unlimited number of different users

questions.explanation_es: Un token de acceso con vida corta reduce el impacto si se filtra o es robado, ya que deja de ser utilizable poco después, limitando la ventana de tiempo en la que un atacante podría usarlo.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: By default, how many IP hops away can an eBGP neighbor be before the session requires 'ebgp-multihop' to be configured?

options.A: eBGP peers are expected to be directly connected (one IP hop away); reaching a neighbor more than one hop away requires 'ebgp-multihop' to be configured
options.B: eBGP sessions can only be established between loopback interfaces
options.C: Any number, since eBGP has no hop-count restriction by default
options.D: eBGP always requires exactly two intermediate hops regardless of configuration

questions.explanation_es: Por defecto, eBGP espera que los vecinos estén conectados directamente (a un salto IP); para establecer una sesión eBGP hacia un vecino a más de un salto de distancia hace falta configurar 'ebgp-multihop'.

questions.name: EtherChannel
questions.question: Which LACP mode combination will NOT form an EtherChannel bundle?

options.A: Active and passive
options.B: Active and active
options.C: Passive and passive
options.D: On and on

questions.explanation_es: Con passive y passive, ninguno de los dos extremos inicia activamente la negociación LACP, por lo que el canal nunca llega a formarse; al menos un lado debe estar en modo active.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which IGMP version introduced the source-specific membership reports required by SSM (Source-Specific Multicast)?

options.A: IGMPv2
options.B: IGMPv1
options.C: IGMPv3
options.D: IGMPv4

questions.explanation_es: IGMPv3 introdujo los reportes de membresía con filtrado por fuente (listas include/exclude), una capacidad necesaria para que SSM funcione; no existe una versión IGMPv4.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which HTTP method is typically used to retrieve a list of devices from the Catalyst Center Intent API?

options.A: GET
options.B: POST
options.C: DELETE
options.D: PUT

questions.explanation_es: GET es el método HTTP estándar para recuperar datos sin modificarlos, por lo que es el que se usa para consultar la lista de dispositivos desde la API de Catalyst Center.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: In a traditional 3-tier campus design, which layer is primarily responsible for high-speed backbone switching between distribution blocks?

options.A: Edge layer
options.B: Access layer
options.C: Distribution layer
options.D: Core layer

questions.explanation_es: La capa core es responsable del switching troncal de alta velocidad entre los distintos bloques de distribución, sin realizar la política/agregación que corresponde a la capa de distribución.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which QoS mechanism actively drops packets before a queue becomes completely full, in order to avoid TCP global synchronization?

options.A: Traffic shaping
options.B: Classification and marking
options.C: Weighted Random Early Detection (WRED)
options.D: Low Latency Queuing (LLQ)

questions.explanation_es: WRED descarta paquetes de forma aleatoria y anticipada antes de que la cola se llene por completo, evitando la sincronización global de TCP que ocurriría si muchos flujos TCP reaccionaran al mismo tiempo a un descarte por cola llena (tail drop).

questions.name: VRF
questions.question: What does 'VRF-lite' specifically refer to, as opposed to a full MPLS VPN-based VRF deployment?

options.A: A cloud-only version of VRF available exclusively on virtual routers
options.B: A VRF implementation limited to exactly two routes per table
options.C: A VRF that only supports IPv6 addressing
options.D: Running VRFs on a router without requiring MPLS or a dedicated PE/CE architecture to exchange routes between VRFs and the rest of the network

questions.explanation_es: VRF-lite permite correr múltiples VRFs en un router sin necesitar MPLS ni una arquitectura PE/CE dedicada para intercambiar rutas entre VRFs y el resto de la red, a diferencia de un despliegue de VPN MPLS completo.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes TACACS+ from RADIUS in terms of packet encryption?

options.A: TACACS+ encrypts the entire packet body, while RADIUS encrypts only the password field
options.B: RADIUS encrypts the entire packet body, while TACACS+ encrypts only the password field
options.C: Both protocols encrypt the entire packet body identically
options.D: Neither protocol encrypts any part of the packet by default

questions.explanation_es: TACACS+ cifra todo el cuerpo del paquete, mientras que RADIUS por defecto solo cifra el campo de contraseña, dejando el resto del paquete (incluyendo atributos) sin cifrar.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which traffic does Control Plane Policing (CoPP) protect, as opposed to a standard interface ACL?

options.A: Traffic destined to a specific VLAN's SVI only
options.B: Traffic destined to the device's own CPU/route processor, such as routing protocol or management traffic
options.C: Traffic transiting through the device from one interface to another
options.D: Traffic leaving the device toward an upstream ISP

questions.explanation_es: CoPP protege específicamente el tráfico destinado a la CPU/route processor del propio dispositivo (protocolos de enrutamiento, gestión, etc.), a diferencia de una ACL de interfaz que filtra tráfico de tránsito.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: In security operations, what does an 'Indicator of Compromise' (IoC) typically represent?

options.A: A forward-looking prediction of an attacker's future intentions
options.B: Observable evidence (such as a known-malicious file hash, IP, or domain) that a system may already have been compromised
options.C: A regulatory requirement for annual security audits
options.D: The physical location of a data center's backup site

questions.explanation_es: Un IoC es evidencia observable (como un hash de archivo malicioso conocido, una IP o un dominio) de que un sistema puede haber sido comprometido, a diferencia de un Indicador de Ataque (IoA) que es más predictivo/conductual.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: What is a 'downloadable ACL' (dACL) in a Cisco ISE authorization policy?

options.A: An ACL pushed from ISE to the switch as part of the RADIUS authorization result, applied to the specific authenticated session
options.B: An ACL that must be manually typed on each switch before ISE can reference it
options.C: A wireless-only ACL type with no wired equivalent
options.D: An ACL that only filters traffic between two ISE nodes in a distributed deployment

questions.explanation_es: Una dACL se descarga dinámicamente desde ISE al switch como parte del resultado de autorización RADIUS, y se aplica a la sesión específica del usuario/dispositivo autenticado.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which syslog severity level indicates the most critical condition, making a system unusable?

options.A: Level 0 (Emergency)
options.B: Level 7 (Debugging)
options.C: Level 4 (Warning)
options.D: Level 6 (Informational)

questions.explanation_es: El nivel 0 (Emergency) es el más crítico de los niveles de severidad de syslog, indicando que el sistema está inutilizable; el nivel 7 (Debugging) es el menos severo.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: In a 'collapsed core' (2-tier) design, which two traditional layers are combined into one?

options.A: Access and distribution
options.B: Distribution and core
options.C: Core and access
options.D: WAN edge and core

questions.explanation_es: En un diseño de núcleo colapsado (2 capas), las funciones de distribución y núcleo se combinan en un solo par de switches, eliminando la capa de núcleo separada del diseño tradicional de 3 capas.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: What does a vSwitch's 'uplink' port typically connect to?

options.A: The physical NIC(s) of the hypervisor host, providing external connectivity for the virtual network
options.B: The hypervisor's own console port
options.C: Another VM's virtual NIC on the same host
options.D: A dedicated management-only VLAN with no external connectivity

questions.explanation_es: El puerto uplink de un vSwitch se conecta a la(s) NIC(s) física(s) del host hipervisor, dando conectividad externa a la red virtual hacia la red física.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: What does Catalyst Center's 'Path Trace' tool help an administrator do?

options.A: Track the physical GPS location of a mobile device
options.B: Generate a bill of materials for licensing
options.C: Visualize the hop-by-hop path between two endpoints and identify potential issues (like ACLs or QoS) along that path
options.D: Automatically rewrite the routing table to shorten the path between two hosts

questions.explanation_es: Path Trace visualiza el camino salto por salto entre dos endpoints e identifica posibles problemas (como ACLs o políticas de QoS) a lo largo de ese camino.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: When SSO is combined with NSF (Nonstop Forwarding), what capability does this add during a supervisor switchover?

options.A: It requires a full reboot of every line card during switchover
options.B: It only applies to Layer 2 switching, never to routed traffic
options.C: The device continues forwarding known routes using the existing FIB while the new active supervisor rebuilds its routing protocol adjacencies, rather than dropping traffic during that period
options.D: It disables all routing protocols until the switchover completes

questions.explanation_es: NSF junto con SSO permite que el dispositivo siga reenviando tráfico usando la FIB existente mientras la nueva supervisora activa reconstruye sus adyacencias de protocolo de enrutamiento, evitando la pérdida de tráfico durante el switchover.

questions.name: NTP/PTP
questions.question: In NTP, what does a device's 'stratum' number represent?

options.A: The encryption strength used for NTP authentication
options.B: The number of NTP clients a server can support simultaneously
options.C: The physical rack unit height of the NTP appliance
options.D: The number of hops from that device to the authoritative reference clock (stratum 0)

questions.explanation_es: El stratum representa la distancia jerárquica (en saltos) de un dispositivo respecto al reloj de referencia autoritativo (stratum 0); un stratum más bajo indica una fuente de tiempo más cercana a la referencia autoritativa.

questions.name: NAT/PAT
questions.question: What is the key difference between static NAT and dynamic NAT?

options.A: Static NAT can only be used with IPv6, dynamic NAT only with IPv4
options.B: Static NAT requires a routing protocol; dynamic NAT does not
options.C: Static NAT creates a fixed, permanent one-to-one mapping between a specific inside address and a specific outside address; dynamic NAT assigns addresses from a pool as needed
options.D: Dynamic NAT always uses port translation, while static NAT never does

questions.explanation_es: El NAT estático crea un mapeo fijo y permanente uno-a-uno entre una dirección interna específica y una externa específica; el NAT dinámico asigna direcciones de un pool según se necesiten, sin un mapeo permanente predefinido.

questions.name: Policy-based routing
questions.question: In a PBR route-map, what does the 'match' clause do, as distinct from the 'set' clause?

options.A: 'match' defines which traffic the sequence applies to; 'set' defines the action taken on that matched traffic
options.B: 'match' defines the action taken; 'set' defines which traffic is selected
options.C: 'match' and 'set' are interchangeable keywords with identical function
options.D: 'match' only applies to BGP route-maps, never to PBR

questions.explanation_es: 'match' define qué tráfico selecciona esa secuencia del route-map, mientras que 'set' define la acción (como el next-hop) que se aplica a ese tráfico ya seleccionado.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: What is the purpose of the Reverse Path Forwarding (RPF) check in PIM?

options.A: To translate multicast group addresses into unicast addresses
options.B: To limit the maximum number of receivers per group
options.C: To encrypt multicast traffic between the source and receivers
options.D: To verify that a multicast packet arrived on the interface the router would use to route back toward the source, preventing loops

questions.explanation_es: El chequeo RPF verifica que un paquete multicast llegó por la interfaz que el router usaría para enrutar de vuelta hacia la fuente, lo cual previene loops en la distribución del tráfico multicast.

questions.name: EEM applets
questions.question: Which of the following is a valid EEM applet event detector?

options.A: 'event vlan-prune' — triggers when VTP pruning removes a VLAN
options.B: 'event syslog' — triggers based on a matching syslog message pattern
options.C: 'event ospf-only' — a detector exclusive to OSPF adjacency changes
options.D: 'event dns-lookup' — triggers whenever a DNS query fails

questions.explanation_es: 'event syslog' es un detector de eventos real de EEM que dispara el applet cuando un mensaje de syslog coincide con un patrón definido; los otros tres nombres no son detectores de eventos reales de EEM.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: How many privilege levels does Cisco IOS support by default, and which is the highest?

options.A: 2 levels only: user and admin
options.B: 256 levels (0-255), with 255 being the highest
options.C: 5 levels (1-5), with 5 being the highest
options.D: 16 levels (0-15), with 15 being the highest (full access)

questions.explanation_es: Cisco IOS soporta 16 niveles de privilegio (0 a 15), siendo el nivel 15 el de acceso completo/administrativo por defecto.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: What is the default TCP port used by NETCONF for its SSH-based transport?
questions.explanation_es: NETCONF sobre SSH usa por defecto el puerto TCP 830, distinto del puerto 22 usado por una sesión SSH de administración CLI tradicional.

questions.name: Trunking 802.1Q
questions.question: What is the default native VLAN on a Cisco switch's 802.1Q trunk, unless explicitly changed?

options.A: VLAN 1
options.B: VLAN 0
options.C: VLAN 4095
options.D: VLAN 1002

questions.explanation_es: La VLAN nativa por defecto en un trunk 802.1Q de Cisco es la VLAN 1, a menos que se configure explícitamente otra distinta.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which NetFlow export format became the basis for the IETF-standardized IPFIX protocol?

options.A: NetFlow Version 9
options.B: NetFlow Version 5
options.C: sFlow
options.D: NetFlow Version 1

questions.explanation_es: NetFlow Versión 9, con su formato de plantillas flexible, fue la base que el IETF usó para estandarizar IPFIX, a diferencia de la versión 5 que tiene un formato de registro fijo.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Which IP SLA operation type most closely resembles a basic, repeated ping test?

options.A: ICMP echo
options.B: UDP jitter
options.C: HTTP
options.D: DNS

questions.explanation_es: La operación ICMP echo de IP SLA es funcionalmente similar a un ping repetido y programado, midiendo alcanzabilidad y tiempo de ida y vuelta básico.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: What additional requirement does RSPAN have that local SPAN does not?

options.A: RSPAN requires a Layer 3 routed link between source and destination
options.B: A dedicated RSPAN VLAN must be configured and trunked across the intermediate switches between the source and destination
options.C: RSPAN requires disabling STP on all intermediate switches
options.D: RSPAN can only mirror ingress traffic, never egress

questions.explanation_es: RSPAN requiere configurar una VLAN RSPAN dedicada y llevarla mediante trunk a través de los switches intermedios entre el origen y el destino, algo que el SPAN local (dentro de un mismo switch) no necesita.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which Catalyst Center API category is designed to work with multivendor network devices via standard protocols like SNMP and NETCONF, rather than Cisco-specific intent-based APIs?

options.A: Intent API
options.B: Multivendor SDK / Integration API
options.C: Assurance API
options.D: Template Programmer API

questions.explanation_es: El SDK/API multivendor de Catalyst Center está pensado para trabajar con dispositivos de red de otros fabricantes a través de protocolos estándar como SNMP y NETCONF, a diferencia de las Intent APIs que son específicas de Cisco.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: In Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, which controller is responsible for orchestrating the initial secure connection between WAN Edge devices and the rest of the control plane?

options.A: vBond
options.B: vManage
options.C: vSmart
options.D: vEdge Cloud

questions.explanation_es: vBond actúa como el orquestador que ayuda a los WAN Edge a autenticarse y establecer la conexión inicial hacia vSmart y vManage, sirviendo como punto de entrada al fabric SD-WAN.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which queuing mechanism guarantees a minimum bandwidth allocation to a traffic class while still allowing it to use spare bandwidth when other classes are idle?

options.A: Class-Based Weighted Fair Queuing (CBWFQ)
options.B: Strict priority queuing only
options.C: First-In-First-Out (FIFO)
options.D: Weighted Random Early Detection (WRED) alone

questions.explanation_es: CBWFQ asigna un ancho de banda mínimo garantizado a cada clase, pero permite que una clase use ancho de banda adicional disponible cuando otras clases no lo están utilizando.

questions.name: EtherChannel
questions.question: What is the difference between LACP 'active' mode and LACP 'passive' mode on an EtherChannel member port?

options.A: An active-mode port initiates LACP negotiation by sending LACP packets; a passive-mode port only responds if it receives LACP packets first, so at least one side of the link must be active
options.B: Active mode uses LACP while passive mode uses PAgP on the same port
options.C: Passive mode forms the channel faster because it skips negotiation entirely
options.D: Active and passive modes only differ in the maximum number of links they support

questions.explanation_es: El modo activo envía paquetes LACP para iniciar la negociación; el modo pasivo solo responde si recibe paquetes LACP primero, por lo que al menos un extremo del enlace debe estar en modo activo para que se forme el canal.

questions.name: EIGRP vs OSPF
questions.question: Do EIGRP hello and hold timers need to match between neighbors for an adjacency to form?

options.A: Yes, both timers must match exactly
options.B: Only the hello timer must match; hold time is irrelevant
options.C: Only on point-to-point links; multipoint links require matching timers
options.D: No, hold time is locally significant and advertised to the neighbor

questions.explanation_es: A diferencia de OSPF, EIGRP no exige que los timers de hello/hold coincidan entre vecinos: cada router anuncia su propio hold time al vecino, que lo respeta de forma local.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: A switch is configured to log at the 'errors' (severity 3) level. Which messages get logged?

options.A: Severities 0 through 3
options.B: Severities 3 through 7
options.C: All severities regardless of the setting
options.D: Only severity 3

questions.explanation_es: En syslog de Cisco, configurar un nivel de logging incluye ese nivel y todos los más severos (numéricamente menores): el nivel 3 registra 0, 1, 2 y 3.

questions.name: OSPFv2/v3 config
questions.question: Which OSPF LSA type tells other areas how to reach an ASBR located in a different area?

options.A: Type 1
options.B: Type 3
options.C: Type 2
options.D: Type 4

questions.explanation_es: La LSA Tipo 4 (ASBR Summary) es originada por el ABR para anunciar la ruta hacia el ASBR a otras áreas, ya que las LSAs Tipo 5 (externas) no incluyen esa información de alcanzabilidad interna.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which of these is NOT used by NETCONF?

options.A: YANG
options.B: HTTP
options.C: XML
options.D: SSH

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF usa SSH como transporte, XML como formato de codificación y YANG como lenguaje de modelado; HTTP es el transporte que usa RESTCONF, no NETCONF.

questions.name: STP/RSTP/MST, root guard, BPDU guard
questions.question: Two switches have matching MST configuration names and revision numbers, but a different VLAN-to-instance mapping table. What happens?

options.A: They still join the same MST region
options.B: STP stops running on both switches
options.C: Only the mapping table is ignored; they merge normally
options.D: They end up in different MST regions

questions.explanation_es: Nombre, número de revisión y tabla de mapeo VLAN-instancia deben coincidir exactamente para que dos switches pertenezcan a la misma región MST; si alguno difiere, terminan en regiones distintas y se comunican vía IST/CST.

questions.name: Códigos de respuesta REST API
questions.question: What HTTP status code does a successful RESTCONF GET request against Catalyst Center typically return?
questions.explanation_es: Un GET exitoso responde con 200 OK; 201 se reserva para creación de recursos (POST) y 204 para respuestas sin contenido.

questions.name: HSRP/VRRP
questions.question: In an HSRP virtual MAC address like 0000.0c07.acXX, what does 'XX' represent?

options.A: The physical interface index
options.B: The router's priority value
options.C: A random value assigned at each election
options.D: The HSRP group number, in hex

questions.explanation_es: El formato estándar de la MAC virtual de HSRP es 0000.0c07.acXX, donde XX es el número de grupo HSRP expresado en hexadecimal.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Which statements about SSH on Cisco devices are correct? (Choose three.)

options.A: It's enabled with 'ip ssh version 2'
options.B: It's less secure than Telnet
options.C: Credentials are never sent in plaintext
options.D: SSH version 2 is preferred over version 1

questions.explanation_es: SSHv2 es la versión recomendada, se activa con 'ip ssh version 2', y a diferencia de Telnet cifra todo el intercambio, incluyendo las credenciales — por eso es MÁS seguro que Telnet, no menos.

questions.name: STP/RSTP/MST, root guard, BPDU guard
questions.question: Which two commands manually clear an err-disabled port after fixing the root cause? (Choose two.)

options.A: errdisable recovery cause bpduguard
options.B: errdisable detect cause bpduguard
options.C: no shutdown
options.D: shutdown

questions.explanation_es: Para recuperar manualmente un puerto en estado err-disable se alterna 'shutdown' seguido de 'no shutdown'; 'errdisable recovery cause' configura, en cambio, la recuperación automática, no manual.

questions.name: NAT/PAT
questions.question: What is the default idle timeout for a dynamic NAT translation entry on Cisco IOS?

options.A: 24 hours
options.B: 12 hours
options.C: 4 hours
options.D: 48 hours

questions.explanation_es: El timeout por defecto de una traducción NAT dinámica en Cisco IOS es de 24 horas (86400 segundos), configurable con 'ip nat translation timeout'.

questions.name: EIGRP vs OSPF
questions.question: Which command lists exactly the interfaces participating in an EIGRP process?

options.A: show ip eigrp neighbors
options.B: show ip eigrp interfaces
options.C: show ip route eigrp
options.D: show ip protocols

questions.explanation_es: 'show ip eigrp interfaces' lista específicamente las interfaces habilitadas para ese proceso EIGRP; 'show ip protocols' da un resumen genérico de todos los protocolos de enrutamiento activos.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Cisco StackWise connects member switches using which physical topology?

options.A: Bidirectional ring, via stack cables
options.B: Point-to-point full mesh
options.C: Star, through a central switch
options.D: Bus, sharing a single cable

questions.explanation_es: Los cables de stack de StackWise forman un anillo bidireccional cerrado entre los switches miembro, lo que da redundancia: el stack sigue funcionando aunque se corte un enlace del anillo.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: What term describes a network function (like a virtual router or firewall) running as a VM on a hypervisor?

options.A: NFVI
options.B: NFVIS
options.C: NFV
options.D: VNF

questions.explanation_es: Una VNF (Virtual Network Function) es la función de red virtualizada en sí (por ejemplo, un router o firewall virtual) ejecutándose como VM; NFV es el marco/arquitectura general, y NFVI es la infraestructura subyacente que la hospeda.

questions.name: EtherChannel
questions.question: Which command load-balances an EtherChannel based on Layer 2 source/destination MAC address?

options.A: port-channel load-balance src-dst-mac
options.B: port-channel load-balance src-mac
options.C: port-channel load-balance dst-mac
options.D: port-channel load-balance src-dst-ip

questions.explanation_es: 'src-dst-mac' balancea usando tanto la MAC origen como la destino, el criterio de Capa 2 solicitado; las otras variantes solo usan un extremo del par o se basan en IP (Capa 3).

questions.name: EIGRP vs OSPF
questions.question: Redistributing EIGRP AS 100 into OSPF process 2 as external type 1, including subnets — which command is correct?

options.A: redistribute eigrp 100 metric-type 1
options.B: redistribute eigrp 100 subnets metric-type 2
options.C: redistribute ospf 2 subnets metric-type 1
options.D: redistribute eigrp 100 subnets metric-type 1

questions.explanation_es: 'metric-type 1' marca las rutas como External Type 1 (E1), y 'subnets' es obligatorio para redistribuir subredes (sin esa palabra clave, OSPF solo redistribuiría redes classful).

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Under congestion, EF-marked traffic competes with AF43 traffic for insufficient bandwidth. What happens?

options.A: Neither is dropped; queuing delays both instead
options.B: AF43 is dropped; EF is prioritized
options.C: Both are dropped equally
options.D: EF is dropped to protect AF43

questions.explanation_es: EF (Expedited Forwarding) recibe tratamiento de cola de prioridad estricta; cuando falta ancho de banda, el tráfico AF43 es el que se descarta, no el EF.
